units.zh: 國初即位儀
units.en: Ceremonies for Succession at the Founding of the State
units.literal: Ceremonies for Succession at the Founding of the State

units.zh: 收國元年春正月壬申朔，諸路官民耆老畢會，議創新儀，奉上即皇帝位。
units.en: In the first year of Shouguo, on the first day of the first month—the day of Renshen at the new moon—officials, commoners, and elders from every circuit assembled. They deliberated on a new enthronement ceremony and presented the regalia for his immediate accession to the throne.
units.literal: In the first year of Shouguo, on the first day of the first month (the day of Renshen at the new moon), officials, commoners, and elders from all circuits gathered; they deliberated on creating a new ceremony and presented [the regalia] to have him immediately take the imperial throne.

units.zh: 阿離合懣、宗翰乃陳耕具九，祝以辟土養民之意。
units.en: Ali Hemen and Zonghan then presented nine farming implements, praying with the intent of opening the land and nourishing the people.
units.literal: Ali Hemen and Zonghan thereupon presented nine farming implements, offering prayers with the meaning of opening the land and nourishing the people.

units.zh: 複以良馬九隊，隊九匹，別為色，並介胄弓矢矛劍奉上。
units.en: They also presented nine teams of fine horses, nine horses per team and each team in a different color, together with armor, helmets, bows, arrows, spears, and swords.
units.literal: Furthermore they presented nine teams of fine horses—nine horses per team, each team in a different color—together with armor, helmets, bows, arrows, spears, and swords.

units.zh: 國號大金，建元收國。
units.en: The state was named Great Jin, and the era name Shouguo was established.
units.literal: The state name was Great Jin; the era name was established as Shouguo.

units.zh: 天會元年九月六日，皇弟諳版孛極烈即皇帝位。
units.en: On the sixth day of the ninth month of Tianhui 1, the emperor's younger brother, the Anban Bojilie, ascended the throne.
units.literal: On the sixth day of the ninth month of the first year of Tianhui, the emperor's younger brother, the Anban Bojilie, immediately took the imperial throne.

units.zh: 己未，告祀天地。
units.en: On the day Jiwei, he announced sacrifices to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: On the day Jiwei, he announced sacrifices to Heaven and Earth.

units.zh: 丙寅，大赦，改元。
units.en: On the day Bingyin, he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.
units.literal: On the day Bingyin, he issued a great amnesty and changed the era name.

units.zh: 受尊號儀
units.en: Ceremonies for Receiving an Honorific Title
units.literal: Ceremonies for Receiving an Honorific Title

units.zh: 皇統元年正月二日，太師宗幹率百僚上表，請上皇帝尊號，凡三請，詔允。
units.en: On the second day of the first month of Huangtong 1, Grand Preceptor Zonggan led the entire court in a memorial asking that the emperor accept an honorific title. After three formal petitions, the throne assented.
units.literal: On the second day of the first month of the first year of Huangtong, Grand Preceptor Zonggan led the hundred officials in submitting a memorial requesting that the emperor be given an honorific title; they petitioned three times, and an edict granted consent.

units.zh: 七日，遣上京留守奭告天地社稷，析津尹宗強告太廟。
units.en: On the seventh day, the Shangjing stay-behind administrator Shi was sent to report the event to Heaven, Earth, and the altars of soil and grain, while Xijin prefect Zongqiang made the announcement at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On the seventh day, the Shangjing garrison commander Shi was dispatched to announce to Heaven, Earth, and the altars of soil and grain; the Xijin prefect Zongqiang announced to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 十日，帝服袞冕禦元和殿，宗幹率百僚恭奉冊禮。
units.en: On the tenth day the emperor, robed in full ceremonial dress, took his seat in the Yuanhe Hall while Zonggan led the court in presenting the investiture ceremony.
units.literal: On the tenth day, the emperor, wearing dragon robes and the imperial cap, took the throne in the Yuanhe Hall; Zonggan led the hundred officials in reverently presenting the investiture rites.

units.zh: 冊文云云，「臣等謹奉玉冊、玉寶，上尊號曰崇天體道欽明文武聖德皇帝」。
units.en: The investiture text declared, in substance: "We your subjects respectfully present the jade book and jade seal, offering the honorific title Sagely Emperor Who Reveres Heaven, Embodies the Way, and Is Illustrious in Civil and Martial Virtue."
units.literal: The text of the investiture document read, in effect: "We your subjects respectfully present the jade book and jade seal, offering the honorific title Sagely Emperor Who Reveres Heaven, Embodies the Way, and Is Illustrious in Civil and Martial Virtue."

units.zh: 是日，皇帝改服通天冠，宴二品以上官及高麗、夏國使。
units.en: That same day the emperor changed into court dress with the Tongtian cap and hosted a banquet for officials of the second rank and above, together with envoys from Goryeo and Western Xia.
units.literal: That same day the emperor changed into the Tongtian cap and gave a banquet for officials of the second rank and above, as well as envoys from Goryeo and Western Xia.

units.zh: 十二日，恭謝祖廟，還禦宣和門，大赦，改元。
units.en: On the twelfth day he offered thanks at the ancestral temple, then returned to take the throne at the Xuanhe Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.
units.literal: On the twelfth day he offered thanks at the ancestral temple, returned to take the throne at the Xuanhe Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.

units.zh: 大定七年，恭上皇帝尊號。
units.en: In Dading 7 the court respectfully bestowed an honorific title upon the emperor.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Dading, the emperor was respectfully given an honorific title.

units.zh: 前三日，遣使奏告天地宗廟社稷。
units.en: Three days in advance, envoys were sent to announce the event to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: Three days beforehand, envoys were dispatched to report to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 前二日，諸司停奏刑罰文字。
units.en: Two days in advance, every office suspended submissions relating to criminal punishments.
units.literal: Two days beforehand, all offices ceased submitting documents concerning punishments.

units.zh: 百官習儀于大安殿庭。
units.en: All officials rehearsed the ceremony in the courtyard of the Da'an Hall.
units.literal: The hundred officials rehearsed the ceremony in the courtyard of the Da'an Hall.

units.zh: 兵部帥其屬，設黃麾仗于大安殿門之內外。
units.en: The Ministry of War led its staff in posting the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the Da'an Hall gates.
units.literal: The Ministry of War led its subordinates in setting up the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the gates of the Da'an Hall.

units.zh: 宣徽院帥儀鸞司，於前一日設受冊寶壇于大安殿中間，又設禦榻於壇上，又設冊寶幄次於大安殿門外，及設皇太子幕次於殿東廊，又設群官次於大安門外。
units.en: The Xuanhui Court directed the Ceremonial Escort Office. On the eve of the ceremony they erected the altar for receiving the investiture book and seal in the center of the Da'an Hall, placed the imperial couch upon it, pitched the book-and-seal canopy outside the hall gate, arranged the crown prince's pavilion in the eastern corridor, and set out pavilions for the officials outside the Da'an Gate.
units.literal: The Xuanhui Court led the Ceremonial Escort Office; on the day before they set up the altar for receiving the book and seal in the center of the Da'an Hall, also set the imperial couch upon the altar, also set up the book-and-seal canopy outside the Da'an Hall gate, also set up the crown prince's pavilion in the eastern corridor of the hall, and also set up the officials' pavilions outside the Da'an Gate.

units.zh: 大樂令與協律郎前一日設宮縣於殿庭，又設登歌樂架於殿上，立舞表于殿下。
units.en: On the day before, the Director of Grand Music and the pitch officers set up the palace bell-chime ensemble in the courtyard, placed the ascending-song music frame on the hall platform, and marked out the dance positions below the hall.
units.literal: The Director of Grand Music and the pitch-regulating officers, on the day before, set up the palace bell-chime ensemble in the hall courtyard, also set up the ascending-song music frame on the hall platform, and erected the dance markers below the hall.

units.zh: 符寶郎其日俟文武群官入，奉八寶置於御座左右，候上冊寶訖，複舁寶還所司。
units.en: That day, once the civil and military officials had entered, the seal-and-treasure officers brought forward the eight imperial treasures and set them on either side of the throne; after the investiture rites concluded, they carried the treasures back to their office.
units.literal: On that day the seal-and-treasure officers, after the civil and military officials had entered, presented the eight treasures and placed them to the left and right of the imperial seat; when the presentation of book and seal was finished, they again lifted the treasures and returned them to their office.

units.zh: 其日質明，奉冊太尉、奉寶司徒、讀冊中書令、讀寶侍中以次應行事官，並集於尚書省，俟冊寶興，乘馬奉迎。
units.en: At dawn that day the Grand Commandant charged with presenting the book, the Minister of Education with the seal, the Director of the Secretariat to read the book, the Palace Attendant to read the seal, and the other ritual officers in their proper order all gathered at the Department of State Affairs. When the book and seal were lifted, they mounted and rode out to escort them.
units.literal: At dawn that day the Grand Commandant who would present the book, the Minister of Education who would present the seal, the Director of the Secretariat who would read the book, the Palace Attendant who would read the seal, and in order all the other officers charged with the rites assembled at the Department of State Affairs; they waited until the book and seal were raised, then mounted horses to escort them in welcome.

units.zh: 冊寶至應天門，下馬由正門步導入，至大安殿門外，置冊寶於幄次。
units.en: When the book and seal reached the Yingtian Gate, the escorts dismounted and led them in on foot through the main gate as far as the Da'an Hall, where they were set down in the canopy pavilion outside the gate.
units.literal: When the book and seal reached the Yingtian Gate, they dismounted and entered on foot through the main gate in procession, arriving outside the Da'an Hall gate, where the book and seal were placed in the canopy pavilion.

units.zh: 舁冊寶床弩手人等分立於左右。
units.en: Bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, and attendants of that kind stood in ranks to the left and right.
units.literal: The bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, and the like stood in separate ranks to left and right.

units.zh: 文武群官並朝服入次。
units.en: Civil and military officials alike entered their assigned stations in full court dress.
units.literal: The civil and military officials all entered their stations in court dress.

units.zh: 攝太常卿與大樂令帥工人入就位，協律郎各就舉麾位。
units.en: The acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Director of Grand Music led the musicians to their stations, and each pitch officer took up his baton position.
units.literal: The acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Director of Grand Music led the musicians to take their places; each pitch-regulating officer took his position for raising the baton.

units.zh: 舁冊寶案官由西偏門先入，置案於殿東西間褥位，置訖，各退於西階冊寶位後。
units.en: Bearers of the book-and-seal tables entered first through the western side gate and set the tables on the cushioned stations in the eastern and western bays of the hall; when this was done they withdrew to stand behind the book-and-seal positions on the western steps.
units.literal: The bearers of the book-and-seal tables entered first through the western side gate, set the tables on the cushioned places in the eastern and western bays of the hall, and when finished each withdrew to stand behind the book-and-seal positions on the western steps.

units.zh: 捧冊官，捧寶官、舁冊匣官、舁寶盝官由西偏門先入，至殿西階下冊寶褥位之西，東向立，俟閣門報。
units.en: Book-bearers, seal-bearers, and the men who carried the book casket and seal casket entered through the western side gate, took up positions west of the cushioned book-and-seal station below the western steps, faced east, and waited for the gate officer's signal.
units.literal: The book-bearers, seal-bearers, book-casket bearers, and seal-casket bearers entered first through the western side gate, came to the west of the cushioned book-and-seal place below the western steps of the hall, and stood facing east, awaiting the gate officer's announcement.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中版奏：「中嚴。」
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to announce on the memorial board: "The inner precinct is under strict guard."
units.literal: The communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to report on the memorial board: "The inner guard is strict."

units.zh: 訖，典儀、贊者各就位。
units.en: When this was done, the master of ceremonies and the announcers each took their stations.
units.literal: When this was finished, the master of ceremonies and the announcers each took their places.

units.zh: 閣門官引文武百僚分左右入，於殿階下磚道之東西，相向立。
units.en: Gate officers led the civil and military officials in to left and right, where they stood facing one another along the brick path to the east and west below the hall steps.
units.literal: Gate officers led the civil and military hundred officials to enter to left and right, standing facing one another to the east and west of the brick path below the hall steps.

units.zh: 符寶郎奉八寶由西偏門分入，升置殿上東西間相向訖，分左右立於寶後。
units.en: Seal-and-treasure officers brought the eight imperial treasures in through the western side gate, carried them up, and set them facing one another in the eastern and western bays of the hall; then they took their places to left and right behind the treasures.
units.literal: The seal-and-treasure officers presented the eight treasures, entering separately through the western side gate, ascended and set them facing one another in the eastern and western bays of the hall platform, then stood to left and right behind the treasures.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中版奏：「外辦。」
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to announce: "The outer preparations are complete."
units.literal: The communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to report on the memorial board: "The outer preparations are complete."

units.zh: 扇合，服袞冕以出，曲直甲蓋、侍衛警蹕如常儀。
units.en: The fans closed. The emperor put on full ceremonial robes and emerged, with curved and straight parasols, armored canopies, attendants, and the imperial guard procession arrayed according to the usual protocol.
units.literal: The fans were closed; he donned dragon robes and the imperial cap and came forth; curved and straight parasols, armored canopies, attendants, and the imperial guard procession followed the usual rites.

units.zh: 殿上鳴鞭，訖，殿下亦鳴鞭。
units.en: Whips were cracked on the hall platform, and then below the hall as well.
units.literal: Whips were cracked on the hall platform; when finished, they were also cracked below the hall.

units.zh: 初索扇，協律郎跪，俯伏，興，舉麾。
units.en: At the first signal for the fans, the pitch officers knelt, prostrated themselves, rose, and raised their batons.
units.literal: At the first request for fans, the pitch-regulating officers knelt, prostrated themselves, rose, and raised their batons.

units.zh: 工鼓柷，奏《乾甯之曲》。
units.en: The musicians struck the sounding-stone and performed the "Qianning" suite.
units.literal: The musicians struck the sounding-stone and performed the "Qianning" suite.

units.zh: 出自東房，即座，儀使副添香，爐煙升，扇開，簾卷。
units.en: He emerged from the eastern chamber and took his seat; the deputy ritual envoy added incense, smoke rose from the censer, the fans opened, and the curtains were drawn up.
units.literal: He came out from the eastern chamber, took the seat, the deputy ritual envoy added incense, incense smoke rose, the fans opened, and the curtains were rolled up.

units.zh: 協律郎偃麾，戛敔，樂止。
units.en: The pitch officers lowered their batons, struck the wooden clapper, and the music stopped.
units.literal: The pitch-regulating officers lowered their batons, struck the wooden clapper, and the music ceased.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人自冊寶幄次分引冊，太常卿前導，吏部待郎押冊而行，奉冊太尉、讀冊中書令、舉冊官於冊後以次從之。
units.en: Erudites of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and communication officers led the book out separately from the canopy pavilion. The Director of the Court went ahead as guide, the Vice Minister of Personnel escorted the book, and the Grand Commandant who would present it, the Director of the Secretariat who would read it, and the book-lifting officers followed behind in order.
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the book forth from the book-and-seal canopy; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices went before as guide; the Vice Minister of Personnel escorted the book as it moved; the Grand Commandant presenting the book, the Director of the Secretariat reading the book, and the book-lifting officers followed behind the book in order.

units.zh: 次太常博士、通事舍人二員分引寶，禮部侍郎押寶而行，奉寶司徒、讀寶侍中、舉寶官於寶後以次從之。
units.en: Next, two academicians and communication officers led the seal separately; the Vice Minister of Rites escorted it, and the Minister of Education who would present it, the Palace Attendant who would read it, and the seal-lifting officers followed behind in order.
units.literal: Next, two Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the seal; the Vice Minister of Rites escorted the seal as it moved; the Minister of Education presenting the seal, the Palace Attendant reading the seal, and the seal-lifting officers followed behind the seal in order.

units.zh: 由正門入，宮縣奏《歸美揚功之曲》。
units.en: They entered through the main gate while the palace bell-chime ensemble played the "Returning Beauty and Proclaiming Merit" suite.
units.literal: They entered through the main gate; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Returning Beauty and Proclaiming Merit" suite.

units.zh: 太常卿於冊床前導，至第一墀香案南，藉寶冊褥位上少置。
units.en: The Director of the Court guided the procession before the book table to the south of the incense table on the first terrace and briefly set book and seal down on the cushioned station.
units.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices guided before the book table, reaching the south of the incense table on the first terrace, and briefly set them down on the cushioned book-and-seal place.

units.zh: 太常卿與舉冊寶官退於冊寶稍西，東向立。
units.en: The Director of the Court and the book-and-seal lifting officers withdrew a little to the west and stood facing east.
units.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the book-and-seal lifting officers withdrew slightly to the west of the book and seal and stood facing east.

units.zh: 應博士、舍人立於其後，舁冊寶床弩手、傘子官等又於其後，皆東向。
units.en: Participating academicians and communication officers stood behind them, with bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, and parasol officers still farther back, all facing east.
units.literal: The participating academicians and communication officers stood behind them; bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, parasol officers, and the like stood still farther behind, all facing east.

units.zh: 太尉、司徒、中書令。
units.en: The Grand Commandant, the Minister of Education, and the Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant, the Minister of Education, and the Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 侍中皆於冊後，面北以次立。
units.en: The Palace Attendants all stood behind the book, facing north in their proper order.
units.literal: The Palace Attendants all stood behind the book, facing north in order.

units.zh: 吏部侍郎、禮部侍郎次立于其後。
units.en: The Vice Ministers of Personnel and of Rites stood in the next rank behind them.
units.literal: The Vice Ministers of Personnel and of Rites stood next behind them.

units.zh: 立定，樂止。
units.en: Once everyone was in position, the music stopped.
units.literal: When they had taken their places, the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門舍人分引東西兩班群官合班，轉北向立，中間少留班路。
units.en: Gate officers led the eastern and western ranks to merge, turn north, and stand in formation, leaving a narrow passage down the center.
units.literal: Gate officers separately led the eastern and western ranks of officials to merge formation, turn, and stand facing north, leaving a small passage in the center of the ranks.

units.zh: 俟立定，太常博士、通事舍人四員分引太尉、司徒、中書令、侍中、吏部禮部侍郎以次各複本班，訖，博士、舍人退以俟。
units.en: Once the formation was set, four academicians and communication officers led the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, Director of the Secretariat, Palace Attendant, and the Vice Ministers of Personnel and Rites back to their original ranks in order; the guides then withdrew to wait.
units.literal: When they had taken their places, four Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, Director of the Secretariat, Palace Attendant, and the Vice Ministers of Personnel and Rites each in order back to their original ranks; when finished, the academicians and communication officers withdrew to wait.

units.zh: 初引時，樂奏《歸美揚功之曲》，至位立定，樂止。
units.en: As they were first led forward, the "Returning Beauty and Proclaiming Merit" suite was played; when they reached their stations and stood firm, the music stopped.
units.literal: At the first leading forth, music performed the "Returning Beauty and Proclaiming Merit" suite; when they reached their places and stood firm, the music ceased.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，太尉以下應在位官皆舞蹈，五拜。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and from the Grand Commandant down every official on duty performed the dance-obeisance in five bows.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; from the Grand Commandant down, all officials who should be in attendance performed the dance-obeisance, five bows.

units.zh: 班首出班起居訖，又贊：「再拜。」
units.en: The head of the rank stepped forward to complete the rising-and-bowing salutation, and the announcers called again: "Bow again."
units.literal: The head of the rank stepped from the formation and finished the rising-and-bowing salutation; the announcers again called: "Bow again."

units.zh: 如朝會常儀。
units.en: This followed the usual protocol of a regular court assembly.
units.literal: according to the usual rites of court assembly.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人四員再引太尉、司徒、中書令、侍中、吏禮部侍郎複進至冊寶所稍南，立定。
units.en: Four academicians and communication officers again led the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, Director of the Secretariat, Palace Attendant, and the Vice Ministers of Personnel and Rites forward to a point just south of the book and seal and held position.
units.literal: Four Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers again led the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, Director of the Secretariat, Palace Attendant, and the Vice Ministers of Personnel and Rites forward once more to slightly south of the book-and-seal place and stood firm.

units.zh: 舁冊寶床弩手，傘子官並進前，舉冊寶床興。
units.en: Bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, and parasol officers all stepped forward together and lifted the book-and-seal couch.
units.literal: The bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, and parasol officers all advanced together and raised the book-and-seal couch.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人二員分引冊，太常卿前導，吏部侍郎押冊而行，奉冊太尉、讀冊中書令、舉冊官於冊後以次從之。
units.en: Two academicians and communication officers led the book separately; the Director of the Court went ahead, the Vice Minister of Personnel escorted it, and the Grand Commandant, the Director of the Secretariat, and the book-lifting officers followed behind in order.
units.literal: Two Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the book; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices went before as guide; the Vice Minister of Personnel escorted the book; the Grand Commandant presenting the book, the Director of the Secretariat reading the book, and the book-lifting officers followed behind the book in order.

units.zh: 冊初行，樂奏《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: As the book first moved forward, the "Suning" suite was played.
units.literal: When the book first moved, music performed the "Suning" suite.

units.zh: 次通事舍人、太常博士又二員分引寶，禮部侍郎押寶而行，奉寶司徒、讀寶侍中、舉寶官於寶後以次從之，詣西階下，至冊寶褥位少置冊北，寶南，樂止。
units.en: Next, two more communication officers and academicians led the seal separately; the Vice Minister of Rites escorted it, and the Minister of Education, Palace Attendant, and seal-lifting officers followed behind. They went to the foot of the western steps and briefly set book and seal on the cushioned station with the book to the north and the seal to the south, then the music stopped.
units.literal: Next, two more communication officers and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians separately led the seal; the Vice Minister of Rites escorted the seal; the Minister of Education presenting the seal, the Palace Attendant reading the seal, and the seal-lifting officers followed behind the seal in order; they proceeded to below the western steps, briefly set them down on the cushioned book-and-seal place with the book to the north and the seal to the south, and the music ceased.

units.zh: 舁冊寶床弩手、傘子官等退於後稍西，樂向立。
units.en: Bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, and parasol officers withdrew a little to the rear and west and stood facing east.
units.literal: The bearers of the book-and-seal couch, crossbowmen, parasol officers, and the like withdrew slightly to the rear and west and stood facing east.

units.zh: 捧冊官與舁冊官並進前，取冊匣升。
units.en: Book-bearers and casket bearers advanced together, lifted the book casket, and ascended.
units.literal: The book-bearers and book-casket bearers advanced together, took up the book casket, and ascended.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人分引冊，太常卿側身導冊先升，奉冊太尉、讀冊中書令、舉冊官、捧冊官於冊後以次從升。
units.en: Academicians and communication officers led the book separately while the Director of the Court turned aside to guide it and went up first; the Grand Commandant, Director of the Secretariat, book-lifting officers, and book-bearers followed behind in order as they ascended.
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the book; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices turned aside to guide the book and ascended first; the Grand Commandant presenting the book, the Director of the Secretariat reading the book, the book-lifting officers, and the book-bearers followed behind the book in order as they ascended.

units.zh: 冊初行，樂奏《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: As the book first moved forward, the "Suning" suite was played.
units.literal: When the book first moved, music performed the "Suning" suite.

units.zh: 進至殿上，博士舍人分左右於前楹立以俟，讀冊中書令于欄子外前楹稍西立以俟，舉冊官、捧冊官立於其後。
units.en: On reaching the hall platform, academicians and communication officers took their places to left and right before the front pillar to wait; the Director of the Secretariat who would read the book stood just west of the front pillar outside the railing; book-lifting officers and book-bearers stood behind him.
units.literal: When they reached the hall platform, the academicians and communication officers stood to left and right before the front pillar to wait; the Director of the Secretariat reading the book stood slightly west of the front pillar outside the railing to wait; the book-lifting officers and book-bearers stood behind him.

units.zh: 奉冊太尉從升，至褥位，搢笏，少前跪置訖，執笏，俯伏，興、樂止，退於前楹稍西立以俟。
units.en: The Grand Commandant ascended with them, reached the cushioned station, tucked his tablet in his belt, stepped forward, knelt, and set the book down. He then took up the tablet, prostrated himself, and rose as the music stopped, then withdrew to wait just west of the front pillar.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant presenting the book ascended with them; reaching the cushioned place, he tucked the tablet in his belt, advanced slightly, knelt and set it down; when finished he took the tablet, prostrated himself, rose; the music ceased; he withdrew to stand slightly west of the front pillar to wait.

units.zh: 太常博士立于後。
units.en: The Court academicians stood behind.
units.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians stood behind.

units.zh: 太常卿少退東向立。
units.en: The Director of the Court withdrew a step and stood facing east.
units.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices withdrew slightly and stood facing east.

units.zh: 舁冊官立於其後，皆東向。
units.en: The casket bearers stood behind them, all facing east.
units.literal: The book-casket bearers stood behind them, all facing east.

units.zh: 捧冊官先入，舉冊官次入，讀冊中書令又次入。
units.en: The book-bearers entered first, then the book-lifting officers, and then the Director of the Secretariat who would read the book.
units.literal: The book-bearers entered first, the book-lifting officers entered next, and the Director of the Secretariat reading the book entered after them.

units.zh: 捧冊官四員皆搢笏雙跪捧。
units.en: All four book-bearers tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on both knees to present the book.
units.literal: All four book-bearers tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on both knees to hold the book.

units.zh: 舉冊官二員亦搢笏，兩邊單跪對舉。
units.en: The two book-lifting officers also tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on one knee on either side to raise the book together.
units.literal: The two book-lifting officers also tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on one knee on either side to lift it together.

units.zh: 中書令執笏進，跪稱：「中書令臣某讀冊。」
units.en: The Director of the Secretariat advanced with tablet in hand, knelt, and declared: "Your subject, Director of the Secretariat [name], reads the investiture book."
units.literal: The Director of the Secretariat, tablet in hand, advanced, knelt, and said: "Your subject, Director of the Secretariat So-and-so, reads the book."

units.zh: 讀訖，俯伏，興。
units.en: When he had finished reading, he prostrated himself and rose.
units.literal: When the reading was finished, he prostrated himself and rose.

units.zh: 中書令俟冊興，先退。
units.en: The Director of the Secretariat waited until the book was lifted, then withdrew first.
units.literal: The Director of the Secretariat waited until the book was raised, then withdrew first.

units.zh: 通事舍人引，降自東階，複本班。
units.en: Communication officers led him down the eastern steps and back to his original station.
units.literal: Communication officers led him down by the eastern steps and back to his original rank.

units.zh: 訖，太常卿降複寶床前，舁冊官並進，與捧冊官等取冊匣興，置於殿東間褥位案上，西向。
units.en: When this was done, the Director of the Court came down and returned before the seal couch. Casket bearers advanced together with the book-bearers, lifted the book casket, and set it on the cushioned table in the eastern bay of the hall, facing west.
units.literal: When finished, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices descended and returned before the seal couch; the book-casket bearers advanced together with the book-bearers and the like, took up the book casket, set it on the cushioned table in the eastern bay of the hall facing west.

units.zh: 捧舉冊官等降自東階，還本班。
units.en: Book-bearers, book-lifting officers, and their attendants came down the eastern steps and returned to their stations.
units.literal: The book-bearers, book-lifting officers, and the like descended by the eastern steps and returned to their original ranks.

units.zh: 舁冊官亦退。
units.en: The casket bearers withdrew as well.
units.literal: The book-casket bearers also withdrew.

units.zh: 太常博士引奉冊太尉降自西階，東向立以俟。
units.en: Court academicians led the Grand Commandant down the western steps, where he stood facing east to wait.
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians led the Grand Commandant presenting the book down by the western steps; he stood facing east to wait.

units.zh: 次捧寶官與舁寶官俟讀冊中書令讀訖出，並進前，取寶盝升。
units.en: Next, once the Director of the Secretariat had finished reading the book and withdrawn, seal-bearers and casket bearers advanced together, lifted the seal casket, and ascended.
units.literal: Next the seal-bearers and seal-casket bearers, after the Director of the Secretariat had finished reading the book and come out, advanced together, took up the seal casket, and ascended.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人分引寶，太常卿側身導寶，先升。
units.en: Academicians and communication officers led the seal separately while the Director of the Court turned aside to guide it and went up first.
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the seal; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices turned aside to guide the seal and ascended first.

units.zh: 奉寶司徒、讀寶侍中、舉寶官、捧寶官於寶後以次從升。
units.en: The Minister of Education, Palace Attendant, seal-lifting officers, and seal-bearers followed behind the seal in order as they ascended.
units.literal: The Minister of Education presenting the seal, the Palace Attendant reading the seal, the seal-lifting officers, and the seal-bearers followed behind the seal in order as they ascended.

units.zh: 寶初行，樂奏《肅甯之曲》，進至殿上，博士舍人俱退不升，並於前楹稍西立俟。
units.en: As the seal first moved forward, the "Suning" suite was played. On reaching the hall platform, the academicians and communication officers withdrew without ascending and waited just west of the front pillar.
units.literal: When the seal first moved, music performed the "Suning" suite; when they reached the hall platform, the academicians and communication officers all withdrew without ascending and stood slightly west of the front pillar to wait.

units.zh: 讀寶侍中於欄子外前楹間稍西立以俟。
units.en: The Palace Attendant who would read the seal stood just west of the front pillars outside the railing to wait.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant reading the seal stood slightly west between the front pillars outside the railing to wait.

units.zh: 舉寶官、捧寶官立於其後。
units.en: Seal-lifting officers and seal-bearers stood behind him.
units.literal: The seal-lifting officers and seal-bearers stood behind him.

units.zh: 奉寶司徒從升，至褥位，搢笏，少前跪置，訖，執笏，俯伏，興，樂止。
units.en: The Minister of Education ascended with them, reached the cushioned station, tucked his tablet in his belt, stepped forward, knelt, and set the seal down. He then took up the tablet, prostrated himself, and rose as the music stopped.
units.literal: The Minister of Education presenting the seal ascended with them; reaching the cushioned place, he tucked the tablet in his belt, advanced slightly, knelt and set it down; when finished he took the tablet, prostrated himself, and rose; the music ceased.

units.zh: 司徒退於前楹西，立以俟。
units.en: The Minister of Education withdrew to the west of the front pillar and waited.
units.literal: The Minister of Education withdrew to the west of the front pillar and stood to wait.

units.zh: 太常卿少退，東向立。
units.en: The Director of the Court withdrew a step and stood facing east.
units.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices withdrew slightly and stood facing east.

units.zh: 舁寶官立於其後，皆東向。
units.en: The seal-casket bearers stood behind them, all facing east.
units.literal: The seal-casket bearers stood behind them, all facing east.

units.zh: 捧寶官先入，舉寶官次入，讀寶侍中又次入。
units.en: The seal-bearers entered first, then the seal-lifting officers, and then the Palace Attendant who would read the seal.
units.literal: The seal-bearers entered first, the seal-lifting officers entered next, and the Palace Attendant reading the seal entered after them.

units.zh: 捧寶官四員皆搢笏雙跪捧。
units.en: All four seal-bearers tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on both knees to present the seal.
units.literal: All four seal-bearers tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on both knees to hold the seal.

units.zh: 舉寶官二員亦搢笏兩邊單跪對舉。
units.en: The two seal-lifting officers also tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on one knee on either side to raise the seal together.
units.literal: The two seal-lifting officers also tucked their tablets in their belts and knelt on one knee on either side to lift it together.

units.zh: 侍中執笏進，跪稱：「侍中臣某讀寶。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant advanced with tablet in hand, knelt, and declared: "Your subject, Palace Attendant [name], reads the imperial seal."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant, tablet in hand, advanced, knelt, and said: "Your subject, Palace Attendant So-and-so, reads the seal."

units.zh: 讀訖，俯伏，興。
units.en: When he had finished reading, he prostrated himself and rose.
units.literal: When the reading was finished, he prostrated himself and rose.

units.zh: 侍中俟寶興先退，通事舍人引，降自西階，複本班，訖，舁寶官進前，與捧寶舉寶官等取寶盝興，置於殿之西間褥位案上，東向。
units.en: The Palace Attendant waited until the seal was lifted, then withdrew first; communication officers led him down the western steps back to his station. Casket bearers then advanced with the seal-bearers and seal-lifting officers, lifted the seal casket, and set it on the cushioned table in the western bay of the hall, facing east.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant waited until the seal was raised, then withdrew first; communication officers led him down by the western steps back to his original rank; when finished, the seal-casket bearers advanced together with the seal-bearers and seal-lifting officers, took up the seal casket, and set it on the cushioned table in the western bay of the hall facing east.

units.zh: 捧寶舉寶等與太常卿俱降自西階，及吏部侍郎皆複本班。
units.en: Seal-bearers, seal-lifting officers, and the Director of the Court all came down the western steps together, and the Vice Minister of Personnel returned to his station.
units.literal: The seal-bearers, seal-lifting officers, and the like together with the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices all descended by the western steps, and the Vice Minister of Personnel also returned to his original rank.

units.zh: 舁寶官亦退。
units.en: The seal-casket bearers withdrew as well.
units.literal: The seal-casket bearers also withdrew.

units.zh: 太常博士引奉寶司徒次奉冊太尉，東向立定。
units.en: Court academicians led the Minister of Education and then the Grand Commandant to stand facing east and hold their positions.
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians led the Minister of Education presenting the seal, then the Grand Commandant presenting the book; they stood facing east and held position.

units.zh: 博士舍人贊引太尉司徒進，詣第一墀香案南褥位立定，博士舍人稍退。
units.en: Academicians and communication officers announced and led the Grand Commandant and Minister of Education forward to the cushioned station south of the incense table on the first terrace; the guides then withdrew a step.
units.literal: Academicians and communication officers announced and led the Grand Commandant and Minister of Education forward to the cushioned place south of the incense table on the first terrace and held position; the academicians and communication officers withdrew slightly.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，在位官皆再拜，訖，博士舍人二員引太尉詣東階升，宮縣奏《純誠享上之曲》，至階，止。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on duty bowed twice. Two academicians and communication officers then led the Grand Commandant up the eastern steps while the palace bell-chime ensemble played the "Pure Sincerity in Offering to the Sovereign" suite, which stopped at the foot of the steps.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, two academicians and communication officers led the Grand Commandant to ascend by the eastern steps; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Pure Sincerity in Offering to the Sovereign" suite; at the steps it ceased.

units.zh: 閣門使二員引太尉進至前，立定，樂止。
units.en: Two gate commissioners led the Grand Commandant forward to the front and held position as the music stopped.
units.literal: Two gate commissioners led the Grand Commandant forward to the front and held position; the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門使揖贊太尉拜跪賀，殿下閣門揖百僚躬身，太尉稱「文武百僚具官臣等言」，致賀詞云云，俯伏，興，退至階上。
units.en: Gate commissioners bowed and called for the Grand Commandant to kneel and offer congratulations; below the hall, gate officers signaled the officials to bow forward. The Grand Commandant declared, "We civil and military officials of every rank, your subjects, say," and delivered the congratulatory address; he then prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew to the steps.
units.literal: The gate commissioners bowed and announced for the Grand Commandant to bow, kneel, and offer congratulations; below the hall the gate officers bowed for the hundred officials to bend forward; the Grand Commandant said, "We civil and military officials of every rank, your subjects, declare," and offered words of congratulation, in effect; he prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew to the steps.

units.zh: 博士舍人分引太尉降至東階，初降，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》，複香案南褥位立定，樂止。
units.en: Academicians and communication officers led the Grand Commandant down the eastern steps; as he began his descent, the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; he returned to the cushioned station south of the incense table and held position, and the music stopped.
units.literal: Academicians and communication officers separately led the Grand Commandant down to the eastern steps; as he first descended, the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; he returned to the cushioned place south of the incense table and held position; the music ceased.

units.zh: 博士舍人少退。
units.en: The guides withdrew a step.
units.literal: The academicians and communication officers withdrew slightly.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，太尉、司徒及在位群官俱再拜舞蹈，三稱「萬歲」，又再拜。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and every official on duty bowed twice with ritual dance, thrice cried "Long live the emperor!", and bowed again.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and all officials in attendance alike bowed twice with ritual dance, thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!", and bowed again.

units.zh: 訖，通事舍人引攝侍中升自東階前楹間，躬承旨，退臨階西向，稱：「有制。」
units.en: When this was done, communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant up the eastern steps to the front pillars; he bowed to receive the imperial command, stepped back to the edge of the steps facing west, and announced: "There is an edict."
units.literal: When finished, communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to ascend from the eastern steps to the space before the front pillars; he bowed to receive the edict, withdrew to the edge of the steps facing west, and proclaimed: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，太尉、司徒及在位群官俱再拜，躬身宣詞云云，宣訖，通事舍人引侍中還位。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and all officials on duty bowed twice. Bending forward, the Palace Attendant read out the edict; when he had finished, communication officers led him back to his station.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and all officials in attendance alike bowed twice; he bent forward and proclaimed the text, in effect; when the proclamation was finished, communication officers led the Palace Attendant back to his station.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，階上下應在位群官俱再拜舞蹈，三稱「萬歲」，又再拜。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on and below the steps who was required to attend bowed twice with ritual dance, thrice cried "Long live the emperor!", and bowed again.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials on and below the steps who should be in attendance alike bowed twice with ritual dance, thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!", and bowed again.

units.zh: 訖，博士舍人分引太尉、司徒就百僚位。
units.en: When this was done, academicians and communication officers led the Grand Commandant and Minister of Education separately to the officials' stations.
units.literal: When finished, academicians and communication officers separately led the Grand Commandant and Minister of Education to the hundred officials' stations.

units.zh: 初引，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》，至位立定，樂止。
units.en: As they were led forward, the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; when they reached their stations and held position, the music stopped.
units.literal: As they were first led, the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; when they reached their stations and held position, the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門舍人分引應北面位群官，各分班東西相向立定。
units.en: Gate officers led the officials assigned to north-facing stations into separate east and west divisions, where they stood facing one another and held position.
units.literal: Gate officers separately led the officials who should take north-facing stations; each division stood facing east and west in pairs and held position.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中並自東階，當前楹間，跪奏：「禮畢。」
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant up the eastern steps to the front pillars, where he knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."
units.literal: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant together up from the eastern steps to the space before the front pillars; kneeling, he reported: "The rites are complete."

units.zh: 俯伏，興，引降還位。
units.en: He prostrated himself, rose, was led down the steps, and returned to his station.
units.literal: He prostrated himself, rose, was led down, and returned to his station.

units.zh: 扇合，簾降。
units.en: The folding fans closed and the curtains were lowered.
units.literal: The folding fans closed; the curtains were lowered.

units.zh: 協律郎俯伏，興，舉麾，工鼓柷，奏《乾甯之曲》。
units.en: The pitch officer prostrated himself, rose, and raised his baton; the musicians struck the percussion frame and played "Qianning."
units.literal: The pitch-regulating officer prostrated himself, rose, and raised the baton; the musicians struck the percussion frame; they performed the "Qianning" suite.

units.zh: 降座，入自東房，還後閣，進膳，侍衛警蹕如儀。
units.en: The emperor left the throne, entered through the eastern chamber, and withdrew to the rear pavilion to take his meal, while guards cleared the way as prescribed.
units.literal: He descended from the throne, entered by the eastern chamber, returned to the rear pavilion, and took his meal; the guards cleared the way according to the rites.

units.zh: 扇開，樂止。
units.en: The folding fans opened and the music stopped.
units.literal: The folding fans opened; the music ceased.

units.zh: 捧冊官帥舁冊床人，捧寶官帥舁寶床人，皆升殿取匣、盝，蓋訖，置於床前。
units.en: Book-bearers led the book-couch bearers, and seal-bearers led the seal-couch bearers; all went up to the hall, gathered the caskets and boxes, closed the lids, and set them before the couch.
units.literal: The book-bearers led the book-couch bearers, and the seal-bearers led the seal-couch bearers; all ascended the hall, took the caskets and boxes, replaced the lids when finished, and set them before the couch.

units.zh: 引進司官前導，通事舍人贊引，詣東上閣門上進。
units.en: Officers of the Introduction Office went ahead while communication officers announced the procession; they proceeded to the upper eastern gate and presented the items upward.
units.literal: Introduction Office officers went ahead as guides; communication officers announced and led them; they proceeded to the upper eastern gate and presented the items upward.

units.zh: 通事舍人分引文武百僚等以次出，歸幕次，賜食，以俟上壽。
units.en: Communication officers led the civil and military officials out in turn; they returned to the waiting pavilions, received food, and waited for the longevity rites to begin.
units.literal: Communication officers separately led the civil and military hundred officials and the like to exit in order; they returned to the waiting pavilions, were granted food, and waited for the longevity ceremony.

units.zh: 上冊寶禮畢，有司供辦禦床及與宴群官位，並如曲宴儀。
units.en: Once the book-and-seal presentation rites were finished, the responsible offices arranged the imperial couch and seating for officials attending the banquet, all according to the curved-banquet ceremony.
units.literal: When the book-and-seal presentation rites were complete, the responsible offices furnished the imperial couch and the stations for officials attending the banquet, all according to the curved-banquet rites.

units.zh: 攝太常卿大樂令帥工人入，並協律郎各就舉麾位，俟舍人報。
units.en: The acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Director of Grand Music led the musicians in; each pitch officer took up his baton station and waited for the communication officers' signal.
units.literal: The acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Director of Grand Music led the musicians in; the pitch-regulating officers each took their baton-raising stations and awaited the communication officers' report.

units.zh: 通事舍人引三師以下文武百僚親王宗室等分左右入，至殿階下稍南，東西相向立。
units.en: Communication officers led the Three Preceptors, civil and military officials, imperial princes, and members of the imperial clan to enter in left and right columns; they halted slightly south of the hall steps and stood facing one another east and west.
units.literal: Communication officers led the Three Preceptors and below, civil and military hundred officials, imperial princes, and members of the imperial clan to enter in separate left and right columns; they reached slightly south of the hall steps and stood facing east and west.

units.zh: 通事舍人先引攝侍中版奏：「中嚴。」
units.en: Communication officers first led the acting Palace Attendant to submit a board memorial: "The hall is under strict guard."
units.literal: Communication officers first led the acting Palace Attendant to present a memorial on the board: "The inner hall is under strict guard."

units.zh: 少頃，又奏：「外辦。」
units.en: A moment later he reported again: "All is ready outside."
units.literal: After a short while, he again reported: "The exterior is ready."

units.zh: 扇合，鳴鞭。
units.en: The folding fans closed and the whips were sounded.
units.literal: The folding fans closed; the whips sounded.

units.zh: 協律郎跪，俯伏，興，工鼓柷，宮縣奏《乾甯之曲》。
units.en: The pitch officer knelt, prostrated himself, and rose; the musicians struck the percussion frame while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Qianning."
units.literal: The pitch-regulating officer knelt, prostrated himself, and rose; the musicians struck the percussion frame; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Qianning" suite.

units.zh: 服通天冠、絳紗袍，即座，簾卷。
units.en: Dressed in the Tongtian cap and deep-red gauze robe, the emperor took the throne as the curtains were rolled up.
units.literal: Wearing the Tongtian cap and deep-red gauze robe, he took the throne; the curtains were rolled up.

units.zh: 內侍贊：「扇開。」
units.en: Inner attendants called: "Open the fans."
units.literal: The inner attendants announced: "Open the fans."

units.zh: 殿上下鳴鞭，戛敔，樂止。
units.en: Whips sounded above and below the hall, the percussion clapper was struck, and the music stopped.
units.literal: Whips sounded above and below the hall; the percussion clapper was struck; the music ceased.

units.zh: 儀使副等添香，爐煙升。
units.en: Ceremonial envoys and their deputies added incense, and smoke rose from the censers.
units.literal: The ceremonial envoys and their deputies added incense; smoke rose from the censer.

units.zh: 通事舍人引班首以下合班，樂奏《肅甯之曲》，至北向位，重行立定，中間少留班路。
units.en: Communication officers led the ranking officials to form a single body while "Suning" was played; they reached their north-facing stations, stood in double rows with a slight passage left in the middle, and held position.
units.literal: Communication officers led the head of the ranks and below to form a single body; music performed the "Suning" suite; they reached the north-facing stations, stood in double rows and held position, leaving a slight passage in the middle of the ranks.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中詣東階升，至殿上少立。
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant up the eastern steps; he paused briefly on the hall floor.
units.literal: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to ascend by the eastern steps; reaching the hall, he stood briefly.

units.zh: 閣門舍人引禮部尚書出班前，北向俯伏，跪奏，稱：「禮部尚書臣某言，請允群臣上壽。」
units.en: Gate officers led the Minister of Rites forward before the ranks; facing north, he prostrated himself, knelt, and said: "Your subject, the Minister of Rites, asks that the court be permitted to offer longevity wishes."
units.literal: Gate officers led the Minister of Rites out before the ranks; facing north, he prostrated himself, knelt, and reported, saying: "Your subject, the Minister of Rites So-and-so, declares: We request permission for the hundred officials to offer longevity wishes."

units.zh: 俯伏，興，躬身。
units.en: He prostrated himself, rose, and bowed forward.
units.literal: He prostrated himself, rose, and bent forward.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中少退。
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant back a step.
units.literal: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to withdraw slightly.

units.zh: 舍人贊：「禮部尚書再拜。」
units.en: The announcers called: "The Minister of Rites bows twice."
units.literal: The communication officers announced: "The Minister of Rites bows twice."

units.zh: 訖，贊：「祗候。」
units.en: When he had finished, they called: "Await the imperial response."
units.literal: When finished, they announced: "Await [the imperial response]."

units.zh: 複本班。
units.en: He returned to his station in the ranks.
units.literal: He returned to his original rank.

units.zh: 內侍局進禦床入。
units.en: The Inner Service Bureau brought in the imperial couch.
units.literal: The Inner Service Bureau brought the imperial couch in.

units.zh: 次良醖令于殿下橫階南酹酒，訖，典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: Next the Director of Fine Brews poured a libation south of the transverse steps below the hall; when this was done, the master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: Next the Director of Fine Brews libated wine south of the transverse steps below the hall; when finished, the master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，在位官皆再拜，隨拜三稱「萬歲」，訖，平立。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on duty bowed twice, crying "Long live the emperor!" three times with the bows; when finished, they stood upright.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials in attendance bowed twice; with each bow they thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!"; when finished, they stood upright.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人分引攝上公由東階升。
units.en: Court academicians and communication officers led the acting chief duke up the eastern steps.
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers separately led the acting chief duke to ascend by the eastern steps.

units.zh: 初升，宮縣奏《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: As he began to ascend, the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning."
units.literal: As he first ascended, the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite.

units.zh: 殿上，舍人少退，二閣使揖上公進，至進酒褥位，樂止。
units.en: On the hall floor the guides withdrew a step; two gate commissioners ushered the chief duke forward to the cushioned station for presenting wine, and the music stopped.
units.literal: On the hall floor, the communication officers withdrew slightly; two gate commissioners bowed the chief duke forward to the cushioned place for presenting wine; the music ceased.

units.zh: 宣徽使以爵授上公，上公搢笏，受爵。
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner handed the wine cup to the chief duke, who tucked his tablet under his arm and accepted it.
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner handed the wine cup to the chief duke; the chief duke tucked his tablet and received the cup.

units.zh: 詣榻前跪進。
units.en: He went before the couch, knelt, and presented the cup.
units.literal: He proceeded before the couch, knelt, and presented it.

units.zh: 受爵訖，上公執槃授宣徽使，訖，二閣使揖上公入欄子內，贊：「拜。」
units.en: When the cup had been received, the chief duke took the tray and handed it to the Xuanhui Commissioner; two gate commissioners then ushered him into the railing enclosure and called: "Bow."
units.literal: When he had received the cup, the chief duke took the tray and handed it to the Xuanhui Commissioner; when finished, two gate commissioners bowed the chief duke into the railing enclosure; they announced: "Bow."

units.zh: 跪。
units.en: He knelt.
units.literal: He knelt.

units.zh: 殿下，閣門揖百僚皆躬身。
units.en: Below the hall, gate officers signaled the officials, who all bowed forward.
units.literal: Below the hall, gate officers bowed for the hundred officials, who all bent forward.

units.zh: 通事舍人揖攝侍中進，詣前楹間，躬承旨，退臨階西向稱：「有制。」
units.en: Communication officers ushered the acting Palace Attendant forward to the front pillars; he bowed to receive the imperial command, stepped back to the edge of the steps facing west, and announced: "There is an edict."
units.literal: Communication officers bowed the acting Palace Attendant forward; he proceeded to the space before the front pillars, bowed to receive the edict, withdrew to the edge of the steps facing west, and proclaimed: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，上公及在位群官皆再拜，隨拜三稱「萬歲」，訖，躬身宣曰：「得公等壽酒，與公等內外同慶。」
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and the chief duke and every official on duty bowed twice, crying "Long live the emperor!" three times with the bows. Bending forward, he proclaimed: "Having received your longevity wine, we share this joy with you all, within and without."
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; the chief duke and all officials in attendance bowed twice; with each bow they thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!"; when finished, he bent forward and proclaimed: "Having received your longevity wine, we share this joy within and without with you all."

units.zh: 閣門舍人贊宣諭訖，上公與百僚皆舞蹈五拜，訖，閣門舍人引百僚分班東西序北向立。
units.en: When the gate officers had finished relaying the imperial message, the chief duke and all officials performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow. Gate officers then led the officials into east and west ranks facing north.
units.literal: When the gate officers had finished announcing the imperial instruction, the chief duke and the hundred officials all performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow; when finished, gate officers led the hundred officials to divide into east and west ranks and stand facing north.

units.zh: 博士舍人再引上公自東階升，宮縣奏《肅甯之曲》，至進酒褥位，樂止。
units.en: Academicians and communication officers again led the chief duke up the eastern steps while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; when he reached the cushioned station for presenting wine, the music stopped.
units.literal: Academicians and communication officers again led the chief duke to ascend from the eastern steps; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; when he reached the cushioned place for presenting wine, the music ceased.

units.zh: 上公搢笏，宣徽使授上公槃，上公詣欄子內褥位，跪舉酒，宮縣奏《景命萬年之曲》，飲訖，樂止。
units.en: The chief duke tucked his tablet; the Xuanhui Commissioner handed him the tray; he went to the cushioned station within the railing enclosure, knelt, and raised the wine while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Life Mandate for Ten Thousand Years"; when he had drunk, the music stopped.
units.literal: The chief duke tucked his tablet; the Xuanhui Commissioner handed him the tray; the chief duke proceeded to the cushioned place within the railing enclosure, knelt, and raised the wine; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Life Mandate for Ten Thousand Years" suite; when he had drunk, the music ceased.

units.zh: 上公進受虛爵訖，複褥位，以爵授宣徽使，訖，二閣使揖上公退，內侍局舁禦床出。
units.en: The chief duke stepped forward to receive the empty cup, returned to the cushioned station, and handed the cup back to the Xuanhui Commissioner; two gate commissioners then ushered him away while the Inner Service Bureau carried the imperial couch out.
units.literal: The chief duke advanced and received the empty cup; when finished, he returned to the cushioned place, handed the cup to the Xuanhui Commissioner; when finished, two gate commissioners bowed the chief duke to withdraw; the Inner Service Bureau lifted the imperial couch out.

units.zh: 博士舍人並進前分引，降自東階，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: Academicians and communication officers came forward and led them separately down the eastern steps while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning."
units.literal: Academicians and communication officers all came forward and separately led them down from the eastern steps; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite.

units.zh: 閣門舍人分引東西兩班，隨上公俱複北向位，立定，樂止。
units.en: Gate officers led the east and west divisions; following the chief duke, they all returned to their north-facing stations and held position as the music stopped.
units.literal: Gate officers separately led the east and west divisions; following the chief duke, they all returned to their north-facing stations, held position, and the music ceased.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，在位官皆再拜，三稱「萬歲」，訖，平立。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on duty bowed twice, crying "Long live the emperor!" three times; when finished, they stood upright.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials in attendance bowed twice, thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!", and when finished stood upright.

units.zh: 殿上，通事舍人揖攝侍中進，詣前楹間，躬承旨，退臨階西向，閣門官先揖，百僚躬身，侍中稱：「有制。」
units.en: On the hall floor, communication officers ushered the acting Palace Attendant forward to the front pillars; he bowed to receive the imperial command and stepped back to the edge of the steps facing west. Gate officers bowed first, the officials bent forward, and the Palace Attendant announced: "There is an edict."
units.literal: On the hall floor, communication officers bowed the acting Palace Attendant forward; he proceeded to the space before the front pillars, bowed to receive the edict, withdrew to the edge of the steps facing west; gate officers bowed first, the hundred officials bent forward, and the Palace Attendant proclaimed: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，在位官皆再拜，訖，躬身宣曰：「延王公等升殿。」
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on duty bowed twice. Bending forward, he proclaimed: "We summon the princes and dukes to ascend the hall."
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, he bent forward and proclaimed: "We summon the princes and dukes and the like to ascend the hall."

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，在位官皆再拜，訖，搢笏，舞蹈，又再拜，訖。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on duty bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, and bowed again.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, they tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, and bowed again; when finished.

units.zh: 太常博士、通事舍人引王公以下合赴宴群官，分左右升殿，不與宴群官分左右卷班出，宮縣奏《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: Court academicians and communication officers led the princes, dukes, and other banquet guests to ascend the hall in left and right columns, while officials not attending the banquet filed out in separate columns; the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning."
units.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians and communication officers led the princes and dukes and below, together with all officials attending the banquet, to ascend the hall in separate left and right columns; officials not attending the banquet rolled their ranks and exited in separate left and right columns; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite.

units.zh: 百僚至殿上坐後立，樂止。
units.en: When the officials had reached the hall, taken their seats, and risen to stand behind them, the music stopped.
units.literal: When the hundred officials had reached the hall, taken their seats, and risen to stand, the music ceased.

units.zh: 內侍局進禦床入。
units.en: The Inner Service Bureau brought in the imperial couch.
units.literal: The Inner Service Bureau brought the imperial couch in.

units.zh: 依尋常宴會，再進第一爵酒，登歌奏《聖德昭明之曲》，飲訖，樂止。
units.en: Following the ordinary banquet procedure, the first toast was presented again; the ascending-song ensemble played "Sagely Virtue Clearly Manifest"; when the emperor had drunk, the music stopped.
units.literal: According to the ordinary banquet, the first toast of wine was again presented; the ascending-song ensemble performed the "Sagely Virtue Clearly Manifest" suite; when he had drunk, the music ceased.

units.zh: 執事者行官酒，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》，文舞入，觴行一周，樂止。
units.en: Attendants circulated wine among the officials while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; the civil dance entered, the cups made one round, and the music stopped.
units.literal: Attendants served the officials' wine; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; the civil dance entered; the cups made one round; the music ceased.

units.zh: 尚食局進食，執事者設群官食，宮縣奏《保大定功之舞》，三成，止，出。
units.en: The Bureau of Imperial Food brought in the meal; attendants set out food for the officials while the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Preserving Greatness and Settling Achievement" dance for three passages, then ceased and withdrew.
units.literal: The Bureau of Imperial Food brought in food; attendants set out food for the officials; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Preserving Greatness and Settling Achievement" dance; three passages, then ceased and withdrew.

units.zh: 又進第二爵酒，登歌奏《天贊堯齡之曲》，飲訖，樂止。
units.en: The second toast was presented; the ascending-song ensemble played "Heaven Assists Yao's Age"; when the emperor had drunk, the music stopped.
units.literal: The second toast of wine was again presented; the ascending-song ensemble performed the "Heaven Assists Yao's Age" suite; when he had drunk, the music ceased.

units.zh: 執事者行群官酒，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》，武舞入，觴行一周，樂止。
units.en: Attendants circulated wine among the officials while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; the military dance entered, the cups made one round, and the music stopped.
units.literal: Attendants served wine to the officials; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; the military dance entered; the cups made one round; the music ceased.

units.zh: 尚食局進食，執事者設群官食，宮縣奏《萬國來同之舞》，三成，止，出。
units.en: The Bureau of Imperial Food brought in the meal; attendants set out food for the officials while the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Ten Thousand Realms Come Together" dance for three passages, then ceased and withdrew.
units.literal: The Bureau of Imperial Food brought in food; attendants set out food for the officials; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Ten Thousand Realms Come Together" dance; three passages, then ceased and withdrew.

units.zh: 又進第三爵酒，登歌奏《慶雲之曲》，飲訖，樂止。
units.en: The third toast was presented; the ascending-song ensemble played "Auspicious Clouds"; when the emperor had drunk, the music stopped.
units.literal: The third toast of wine was again presented; the ascending-song ensemble performed the "Auspicious Clouds" suite; when he had drunk, the music ceased.

units.zh: 執事者行群官酒，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》，觴行一周，樂止。
units.en: Attendants circulated wine among the officials while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; the cups made one round and the music stopped.
units.literal: Attendants served wine to the officials; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; the cups made one round; the music ceased.

units.zh: 尚食局進食，執事者設群官食，宮縣奏《肅甯之曲》，食畢，樂止。
units.en: The Bureau of Imperial Food brought in the meal; attendants set out food for the officials while the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning"; when the meal was finished, the music stopped.
units.literal: The Bureau of Imperial Food brought in food; attendants set out food for the officials; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; when the meal was finished, the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門官分揖侍宴群官起，立于席後。
units.en: Gate officers signaled the banquet guests to rise and stand behind their seats.
units.literal: Gate officers separately bowed for the officials attending the banquet to rise; they stood behind their seats.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中詣榻前，俯伏，興，跪奏：「侍中臣某言，禮畢。」
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant before the couch; he prostrated himself, rose, knelt, and reported: "Your subject, the Palace Attendant, declares: The rites are complete."
units.literal: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant before the couch; he prostrated himself, rose, knelt, and reported: "Your subject, the Palace Attendant So-and-so, declares: The rites are complete."

units.zh: 俯伏，興。
units.en: He prostrated himself and rose.
units.literal: He prostrated himself and rose.

units.zh: 閣門舍人分引群官俱降東西階，內侍局舁禦床出，宮縣作《肅甯之曲》，至北向位立定，樂止。
units.en: Gate officers led all officials down the eastern and western steps while the Inner Service Bureau carried the imperial couch out; the palace bell-chime ensemble played "Suning" until they reached their north-facing stations and held position, and the music stopped.
units.literal: Gate officers separately led all officials down the eastern and western steps; the Inner Service Bureau lifted the imperial couch out; the palace bell-chime ensemble performed the "Suning" suite; when they reached their north-facing stations and held position, the music ceased.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 贊者承 傳，在位官皆再拜，訖，搢笏，舞蹈，又再拜，訖，再分班東西序立。
units.en: The announcers relayed the command, and every official on duty bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, and bowed again; they then divided into east and west ranks and stood in order.
units.literal: The announcers passed the command; all officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, they tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, and bowed again; when finished, they again divided into east and west ranks and stood in order.

units.zh: 扇合，簾降，殿上下鳴鞭。
units.en: The folding fans closed, the curtains were lowered, and whips sounded above and below the hall.
units.literal: The folding fans closed; the curtains were lowered; whips sounded above and below the hall.

units.zh: 協律郎俯伏，跪，舉麾，興，工鼓柷，奏《乾甯之曲》。
units.en: The pitch officer prostrated himself, knelt, raised his baton, and rose; the musicians struck the percussion frame and played "Qianning."
units.literal: The pitch-regulating officer prostrated himself, knelt, raised the baton, and rose; the musicians struck the percussion frame; they performed the "Qianning" suite.

units.zh: 降座，入自東房，還後閣，侍衛如來儀。
units.en: The emperor left the throne, entered through the eastern chamber, and withdrew to the rear pavilion; the guards escorted him as on his arrival, according to the rites.
units.literal: He descended from the throne, entered by the eastern chamber, and returned to the rear pavilion; the guards attended as when he had come, according to the rites.

units.zh: 內侍贊：「扇開。」
units.en: Inner attendants called: "Open the fans."
units.literal: The inner attendants announced: "Open the fans."

units.zh: 戛敔，樂止。
units.en: The percussion clapper was struck and the music stopped.
units.literal: The percussion clapper was struck; the music ceased.

units.zh: 通事舍人引攝侍中版奏：「解嚴。」
units.en: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to submit a board memorial: "Strict guard is lifted."
units.literal: Communication officers led the acting Palace Attendant to present a memorial on the board: "Strict guard is lifted."

units.zh: 所司承旨放仗，在位群官皆再拜以次出。
units.en: The responsible offices received the command and dismissed the guard; every official on duty bowed twice and left in turn.
units.literal: The responsible offices received the edict and dismissed the guard; all officials in attendance bowed twice and exited in order.

units.zh: 元日聖誕上壽儀
units.en: Rites for Offering Longevity on New Year's Day and the Emperor's Birthday
units.literal: Rites for Offering Longevity on New Year's Day and the Emperor's Birthday

units.zh: 皇帝升御座，鳴鞭、報時畢，殿前班小起居，各複侍立位。
units.en: The emperor took the imperial throne; whips sounded and the hour was announced. The ranks before the hall performed the brief audience, then each official returned to his attendance station.
units.literal: The emperor ascended the imperial throne; the whips sounded and the time was announced; when finished, the ranks before the hall performed the brief audience; each returned to his attendance station.

units.zh: 舍人引皇太子並臣僚使客合班入，至丹墀，舞蹈五拜，平立。
units.en: Communication officers led the crown prince, ministers, envoys, and guests to enter as one body; reaching the red courtyard, they performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow, then stood upright.
units.literal: Communication officers led the crown prince together with ministers, envoys, and guests to enter in a single body; reaching the red courtyard, they performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow, then stood upright.

units.zh: 閣使奏諸道表目，皇太子以下皆再拜。
units.en: Gate commissioners read the titles of memorials from the various circuits; the crown prince and all below him bowed twice.
units.literal: Gate commissioners reported the memorial titles from the various circuits; the crown prince and below all bowed twice.

units.zh: 引皇太子升殿褥位，搢笏，捧盞盤，進酒，皇帝受置於案。
units.en: They led the crown prince up to the cushioned station on the hall; he tucked his tablet, held the cup and tray, and presented wine; the emperor received it and set it on the table.
units.literal: They led the crown prince to ascend to the cushioned place on the hall; he tucked his tablet, held the cup and tray, and presented wine; the emperor received it and set it on the table.

units.zh: 皇太子退複褥位，轉盤與執事者，出笏，二閣使齊揖入欄子內，拜跪致詞雲：「元正啟祚，品物鹹新，恭惟皇帝陛下與天同休。」
units.en: The crown prince withdrew to the cushioned station, handed the tray to an attendant, and removed his tablet; two gate commissioners bowed together as he entered the railing enclosure; kneeling, he declared: "On New Year's Day the throne is renewed and all things are made new; we respectfully wish that Your Majesty may share Heaven's blessings."
units.literal: The crown prince withdrew to the cushioned place, handed the tray to an attendant, and removed his tablet; two gate commissioners bowed together as he entered the railing enclosure; kneeling and bowing, he delivered words saying: "On the first day of the year the throne is renewed, and all things are made new; we respectfully wish that Your Majesty the Emperor may share Heaven's blessings."

units.zh: 若聖節則雲：「萬春令節，謹上壽卮，伏願皇帝陛下萬歲萬歲萬萬歲。」
units.en: On the emperor's birthday he would instead declare: "On this festive day of ten thousand springs, we respectfully present this longevity cup; we humbly wish that Your Majesty may live ten thousand years, ten thousand years, ten thousand times ten thousand years."
units.literal: If it were the emperor's birthday, he would say: "On this festive day of ten thousand springs, we respectfully present this longevity cup; we humbly wish that Your Majesty the Emperor may live ten thousand years, ten thousand years, ten thousand times ten thousand years."

units.zh: 祝畢，拜，興，複褥位，同殿下群僚皆再拜。
units.en: When the blessing was finished, he bowed, rose, and returned to the cushioned station; together with the officials below the hall, all bowed twice.
units.literal: When the blessing was finished, he bowed, rose, and returned to the cushioned place; together with the officials below the hall, all bowed twice.

units.zh: 宣徽使稱：「有制。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant commissioner announced: "There is an edict."
units.literal: The Commissioner of the Palace Attendant Service announced: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 在位皆再拜，宣答曰：「履新上壽，與卿等內外同慶。」
units.en: All in attendance bowed twice; the announcer replied: "As you tread the new year and offer longevity, we inside and outside the palace celebrate together with you all."
units.literal: All in attendance bowed twice; the announcer replied: "As you tread the new year and offer longevity, inside and outside the palace we celebrate together with you all."

units.zh: 聖節則曰：「得卿壽酒，與卿等內外同慶。」
units.en: On the emperor's birthday he would instead say: "Having received your longevity wine, we inside and outside the palace celebrate together with you all."
units.literal: If it were the emperor's birthday, he would say: "Having received your longevity wine, inside and outside the palace we celebrate together with you all."

units.zh: 詞畢，舞蹈五拜，齊立。
units.en: When the words were finished, they performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow, then stood together.
units.literal: When the words were finished, they performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow, then stood together.

units.zh: 皇太子搢笏，執盤，臣僚分班，教坊奏樂。
units.en: The crown prince tucked his tablet and held the tray; the ministers took their ranks as the Music Bureau played.
units.literal: The crown prince tucked his tablet and held the tray; ministers divided into ranks; the Music Bureau played music.

units.zh: 皇帝舉酒，殿上下侍立臣僚皆再拜。
units.en: The emperor raised his wine, and every minister attending above and below the hall bowed twice.
units.literal: The emperor raised his wine; all attending ministers above and below the hall bowed twice.

units.zh: 皇太子受虛盞，退立褥位，轉盤與執事者，出笏，左下殿，樂止，合班，在位臣僚皆再拜。
units.en: The crown prince received the empty cup, withdrew to the cushioned station, handed the tray to an attendant, and removed his tablet; he descended the hall by the left as the music stopped. They formed a single body, and every official on duty bowed twice.
units.literal: The crown prince received the empty cup, withdrew to the cushioned station, handed the tray to an attendant, removed his tablet, and descended the hall by the left; the music ceased; they formed a single body; all officials in attendance bowed twice.

units.zh: 分引與宴官上殿，次引宋國人從至丹墀，再拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。」
units.en: They separately led the banquet officials up the hall, then led the Song envoys and attendants to the red courtyard; they bowed twice and, without leaving their ranks, reported: "May Your Majesty be in boundless health."
units.literal: They separately led the banquet officials up the hall, then led the Song envoys and attendants to the red courtyard; they bowed twice and, without leaving their ranks, reported: "May Your Majesty be in boundless health."

units.zh: 再拜，喝：「有敕賜酒食。」
units.en: They bowed twice as the crier announced: "By imperial decree, wine and food are granted."
units.literal: They bowed twice; the crier announced: "By imperial decree, wine and food are granted."

units.zh: 又再拜，各祗候，平立，引左廊立。
units.en: They bowed again, each respectfully awaited orders, stood upright, and were led to stand in the left corridor.
units.literal: They bowed again; each respectfully awaited orders; they stood upright and were led to stand in the left corridor.

units.zh: 次引高麗、夏人從，如上儀畢，分引左右廊立。
units.en: Next they led the Goryeo and Xia envoys and attendants; when the rites above were finished, they were separately led to stand in the left and right corridors.
units.literal: Next they led the Goryeo and Xia envoys and attendants; when the rites above were finished, they separately led them to stand in the left and right corridors.

units.zh: 禦果床入，進酒。
units.en: The imperial fruit table was brought in, and wine was served.
units.literal: The imperial fruit table entered, and wine was presented.

units.zh: 皇帝飲，則坐宴侍立臣皆再拜。
units.en: When the emperor drank, every seated banquet official and standing attendant bowed twice.
