units.literal: When the emperor drank, all seated banquet officials and standing attendants bowed twice.

units.zh: 進酒官接盞還位，坐宴官再拜，複坐。
units.en: The wine-presenting officer received the cup and returned to his station; the seated banquet officials bowed twice and resumed their seats.
units.literal: The wine-presenting officer received the cup and returned to his station; the seated banquet officials bowed twice and sat again.

units.zh: 行酒，傳宣，立飲，訖，再拜，坐。
units.en: Wine was circulated and the decree announced; they stood to drink, and when finished bowed twice and sat.
units.literal: Wine was circulated; the decree was announced; they stood to drink; when finished, they bowed twice and sat.

units.zh: 次從人再拜，坐。
units.en: Next the attendants bowed twice and sat.
units.literal: Next the attendants bowed twice and sat.

units.zh: 三盞，致語，揖臣使並從人立。
units.en: At the third round a formal address was delivered, and the envoys and attendants were signaled to rise and stand.
units.literal: At the third round, a formal address was delivered; the envoys and attendants were bowed to and rose to stand.

units.zh: 誦口號畢，坐宴侍立官皆再拜，坐，次從人再拜，坐。
units.en: When the chant was finished, every seated banquet official and standing attendant bowed twice and sat; then the attendants bowed twice and sat.
units.literal: When the chant was finished, all seated banquet officials and standing attendants bowed twice and sat; next the attendants bowed twice and sat.

units.zh: 食入，七盞，曲將終，揖從人立，再拜畢，引出。
units.en: Food was served; at the seventh round, as the music was ending, the attendants were signaled to rise; when the bows were finished, they were led out.
units.literal: Food entered; at the seventh round, as the music was ending, the attendants were bowed to and rose; when the bows were finished, they were led out.

units.zh: 聞曲時，揖臣使起，再拜，下殿。
units.en: When the music was heard, the envoys were signaled to rise; they bowed twice and descended the hall.
units.literal: When the music was heard, the envoys were bowed to and rose; they bowed twice and descended the hall.

units.zh: 果床出。
units.en: The fruit table was removed.
units.literal: The fruit table was removed.

units.zh: 至丹墀，合班謝宴，舞蹈五拜，各祗候，分引出。
units.en: Reaching the red courtyard, they formed a single body to thank the emperor for the banquet, performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow, each respectfully awaited orders, and were separately led out.
units.literal: Reaching the red courtyard, they formed a single body to thank the emperor for the banquet, performed the fivefold ritual dance and bow, each respectfully awaited orders, and were separately led out.

units.zh: 大定六年正月，上禦大安殿，受皇太子以下百官及外國使賀，賜宴，文武五品以上侍坐者有定員，為常制。
units.en: In the first month of the sixth year of Dading, the emperor attended the Da'an Hall, received congratulations from the crown prince, the hundred officials, and foreign envoys, and granted a banquet; civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above who were seated at the banquet had fixed quotas, and this became the regular rule.
units.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Dading, the emperor attended the Da'an Hall, received congratulations from the crown prince down through the hundred officials and foreign envoys, and granted a banquet; civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above who were seated at the banquet had fixed quotas—this was established as the regular rule.

units.zh: 十七年，詔以皇族袒免以上親，雖無官爵封邑，若與宴當有班次。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, an edict declared that imperial clansmen related within the zuxian degree and above, though without office, rank, or fief, should have seat assignments if they attended the banquet.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, an edict declared that imperial clansmen related within the zuxian degree and above, though without office, rank, or fief, if attending the banquet should have seat assignments.

units.zh: 禮官言：「按唐典，皇家周親視三品，大功親、小功尊屬視四品，小功親、緦麻尊屬視五品，緦麻袒免以上視六品。」
units.en: The ritual officers said: "According to Tang regulations, imperial agnates of the first mourning circle are treated as third rank; relatives in the second mourning circle and honored relatives in the third mourning circle as fourth rank; relatives in the third mourning circle and honored relatives in the fourth mourning circle as fifth rank; and relatives in the fourth mourning circle within the zuxian degree and above as sixth rank."
units.literal: The ritual officers said: "According to Tang regulations, imperial agnates of the first mourning circle are treated as third rank; relatives in the second mourning circle and honored relatives in the third mourning circle are treated as fourth rank; relatives in the third mourning circle and honored relatives in the fourth mourning circle are treated as fifth rank; relatives in the fourth mourning circle within the zuxian degree and above are treated as sixth rank."

units.zh: 上命以此制為班次。
units.en: The emperor ordered that this regulation be used for seat assignments.
units.literal: The emperor ordered that this regulation be used for seat assignments.

units.zh: 朝參常朝儀
units.en: Rites for Court Attendance and Regular Morning Audiences
units.literal: Rites for Court Attendance and Regular Morning Audiences

units.zh: 天眷二年五月，詳定常朝及朔，望儀，准前代制，以朔日、六日、十一日、十五日、二十一日、二十六日為六參日。
units.en: In the fifth month of the second year of Tianjuan, the rites for regular morning audiences and for the new and full moons were detailed; following previous dynasties' regulations, the first, sixth, eleventh, fifteenth, twenty-first, and twenty-sixth days were set as the six attendance days.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Tianjuan, the rites for regular morning audiences and for the new and full moons were detailed; following previous dynasties' regulations, the first, sixth, eleventh, fifteenth, twenty-first, and twenty-sixth days were set as the six attendance days.

units.zh: 後又定制，以朔、望日為朝參，余日為常朝。
units.en: Later a new rule was established: the new and full moon days were court attendance, and the remaining days were regular morning audiences.
units.literal: Later a new rule was established: the new and full moon days were court attendance, and the remaining days were regular morning audiences.

units.zh: 凡朔、望朝參日，百官卯時至冪次，皇帝辰刻視朝，供禦弩手、傘子直於殿門外，分兩面排立。
units.en: On new- and full-moon court attendance days, the hundred officials arrived at the screen tent at the mao hour; the emperor held audience at the chen hour; imperial crossbowmen and umbrella bearers were posted outside the hall gate and arranged in two facing rows.
units.literal: On new- and full-moon court attendance days, the hundred officials arrived at the screen tent at the mao hour; the emperor held audience at the chen hour; imperial crossbowmen and umbrella bearers were posted outside the hall gate and arranged in two facing rows.

units.zh: 司辰入殿報時畢，皇帝禦殿坐，鳴鞭。
units.en: The timekeeper entered the hall and announced the hour; the emperor ascended the hall and took his seat, and whips sounded.
units.literal: The timekeeper entered the hall and finished announcing the hour; the emperor ascended the hall and took his seat; whips sounded.

units.zh: 閣門報班齊。
units.en: The gate officers reported that the ranks were assembled.
units.literal: The gate officers reported that the ranks were assembled.

units.zh: 執擎儀物內侍分降殿階兩傍，面南立。
units.en: Inner attendants bearing ritual objects separately descended the hall steps on both sides and stood facing south.
units.literal: Inner attendants bearing ritual objects separately descended the hall steps on both sides and stood facing south.

units.zh: 宿衛官自都點檢至左右親衛，祗應官自宣徽閣門祗候，先兩拜，班首少離位，奏：「聖躬萬福。」
units.en: Palace guard officers from the chief inspector down to the left and right personal guards, and attendant officers from the Palace Attendant and Gate Service attendants, first bowed twice; the rank leader slightly left his position and reported: "May Your Majesty be in boundless health."
units.literal: Palace guard officers from the chief inspector down to the left and right personal guards, and attendant officers from the Palace Attendant and Gate Service attendants, first bowed twice; the rank leader slightly left his position and reported: "May Your Majesty be in boundless health."

units.zh: 兩拜。
units.en: They bowed twice.
units.literal: They bowed twice.

units.zh: 弩手、傘子先於殿門外東西向排立，俟奏「聖躬萬福」時，即就位北面山呼聲喏，起居畢，即相向對立。
units.en: Crossbowmen and umbrella bearers were first arranged east and west outside the hall gate; when "May Your Majesty be in boundless health" was reported, they took their positions, faced north, and shouted in response; when the audience was finished, they faced each other and stood opposite.
units.literal: Crossbowmen and umbrella bearers were first arranged east and west outside the hall gate; when "May Your Majesty be in boundless health" was reported, they took their positions, faced north, and shouted in response; when the audience was finished, they faced each other and stood opposite.

units.zh: 擎禦傘直立左班內侍上。
units.en: The bearer of the imperial umbrella stood upright behind the inner attendants of the left rank.
units.literal: The bearer of the imperial umbrella stood upright behind the inner attendants of the left rank.

units.zh: 都點檢以次升殿，副點檢在少南，東西相向立。
units.en: The chief inspector ascended the hall in order; the deputy inspector stood slightly to the south; east and west they faced each other.
units.literal: The chief inspector ascended the hall in order; the deputy inspector stood slightly to the south; east and west they faced each other.

units.zh: 左右衛在殿下，東西相向立。
units.en: The left and right guards stood below the hall, east and west facing each other.
units.literal: The left and right guards stood below the hall, east and west facing each other.

units.zh: 閣門乃引親王班，贊班首名以下再拜，訖，班首少離位，奏：「聖躬萬福。」
units.en: The gate officers then led the princely ranks and announced the rank leader's name and below to bow twice; when finished, the rank leader slightly left his position and reported: "May Your Majesty be in boundless health."
units.literal: The gate officers then led the princely ranks, announced the rank leader's name and below to bow twice; when finished, the rank leader slightly left his position and reported: "May Your Majesty be in boundless health."

units.zh: 歸位再拜畢，先退。
units.en: They returned to their positions; when the bows were finished, they withdrew first.
units.literal: They returned to their positions; when the bows were finished, they withdrew first.

units.zh: 次引文武百僚班首以下應合朝參官，並府運六品以上官，皆左入，至丹墀之東，西向鞠躬畢，閣門通唱，複引至丹墀。
units.en: Next they led the civil and military hundred officials from the rank leader down who should attend court, together with prefectural and transport officials of the sixth rank and above; all entered from the left, reached the east of the red courtyard, bowed west, the gate officers announced, and they were again led to the red courtyard.
units.literal: Next they led the civil and military hundred officials from the rank leader down who should attend court, together with transport officials of the sixth rank and above; all entered from the left, reached the east of the red courtyard, finished bowing west, the gate officers announced, and they were again led to the red courtyard.

units.zh: 閣門贊班首名以下起居，舞蹈五拜，又再拜，畢，領省宰執升殿奏事。
units.en: The gate officers announced the rank leader's name and below to perform the audience, the fivefold ritual dance and bow, and bow again; when finished, they led the provincial chancellors to ascend the hall and report affairs.
units.literal: The gate officers announced the rank leader's name and below to perform the audience, the fivefold ritual dance and bow, and again bow twice; when finished, they led the provincial chancellors to ascend the hall and report affairs.

units.zh: 殿中侍御史對立于左右衛將軍之北少前，修起居東西對立於殿欄子內副階下，餘退，右出。
units.en: The palace censor stood opposite, slightly forward to the north of the left and right guard generals; the recorders of the audience stood east and west opposite inside the hall railing below the side steps; the remainder withdrew and exited to the right.
units.literal: The palace censor stood opposite, slightly forward to the north of the left and right guard generals; the recorders of the audience stood east and west opposite inside the hall railing below the side steps; the remainder withdrew and exited to the right.

units.zh: 初，帝就坐，置寶匣於殿階上東南角。
units.en: Initially, when the emperor took his seat, the treasure casket was placed at the southeast corner of the hall steps.
units.literal: Initially, when the emperor took his seat, the treasure casket was placed at the southeast corner of the hall steps.

units.zh: 後定制，師傅起居畢，禦案始東入，置定，捧案內侍東西分下，侍殿隅。
units.en: Later a new rule was established: after the tutors' audience was finished, the imperial desk first entered from the east and was placed; inner attendants bearing the desk separately descended east and west and attended the hall corners.
units.literal: Later a new rule was established: after the tutors' audience was finished, the imperial desk first entered from the east and was placed; inner attendants bearing the desk separately descended east and west and attended the hall corners.

units.zh: 直日主寶捧寶當殿叩欄奏：「封全。」
units.en: The chief seal keeper on duty held the seal before the hall, knocked the railing, and reported: "The seal is intact."
units.literal: The chief seal keeper on duty held the seal before the hall, knocked the railing, and reported: "The seal is intact."

units.zh: 符寶郎及當監印郎中各一員，監當手分令史用印，訖，主寶吏封授主寶，俟奏事畢進封，訖，內侍徹案。
units.en: The talisman seal officer and the supervising seal official, one each, supervised the clerks of their sections in using the seal; when finished, the chief seal clerk sealed the documents and handed them to the chief seal keeper; they awaited the completion of the reports, then presented the sealed documents; when finished, the inner attendants removed the desk.
units.literal: The talisman seal officer and the supervising seal official, one each, supervised the clerks of their sections in using the seal; when finished, the chief seal clerk sealed the documents and handed them to the chief seal keeper; they awaited the completion of the reports, then presented the sealed documents; when finished, the inner attendants removed the desk.

units.zh: 若常朝，則親王班退，引七品以上職事官，分左右班入丹墀，再拜，班首稍前起居畢，復位，再拜。
units.en: If it were a regular morning audience, the princely ranks withdrew; seventh-rank and above functional officials were led in left and right ranks into the red courtyard; they bowed twice; the rank leader slightly advanced, performed the audience, returned to position, and bowed twice.
units.literal: If it were a regular morning audience, the princely ranks withdrew; seventh-rank and above functional officials were led in left and right ranks into the red courtyard; they bowed twice; the rank leader slightly advanced, finished the audience, returned to position, and bowed twice.

units.zh: 宰執升殿，余官分班退。
units.en: The chancellors ascended the hall; the remaining officials divided into ranks and withdrew.
units.literal: The chancellors ascended the hall; the remaining officials divided into ranks and withdrew.

units.zh: 大定二年五月，命台臣定朝參禮。
units.en: In the fifth month of the second year of Dading, censorial officials were ordered to fix the rites of court attendance.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Dading, censorial officials were ordered to fix the rites of court attendance.

units.zh: 五品以上官職趨朝朝服，入局治事則展皁。
units.en: Officials of the fifth rank and above wore court robes when hurrying to court; when entering their offices to conduct affairs, they wore black informal robes.
units.literal: Officials of the fifth rank and above wore court robes when hurrying to court; when entering their offices to conduct affairs, they wore black informal robes.

units.zh: 自來朝參，除殿前班外，若遇朔望，自七品以上職事官皆赴。
units.en: For court attendance, besides the hall-front ranks, on new- and full-moon days all functional officials from the seventh rank and above attended.
units.literal: For court attendance, besides the hall-front ranks, on new- and full-moon days all functional officials from the seventh rank and above attended.

units.zh: 其餘朝日，五品以上職事官得赴，六品以下止于本司局治事。
units.en: On other audience days, functional officials of the fifth rank and above might attend; those of the sixth rank and below remained at their bureaus to conduct affairs.
units.literal: On other audience days, functional officials of the fifth rank and above might attend; those of the sixth rank and below remained at their bureaus to conduct affairs.

units.zh: 如左右司員外郎、侍御史、記注院等官職，雖不系五品，亦赴朝參。
units.en: Such posts as vice directors of the Left and Right Secretariats, attendant censors, and the Diaries Office, though not of the fifth rank, also attended court.
units.literal: Such posts as vice directors of the Left and Right Secretariats, attendant censors, and the Diaries Office, though not of the fifth rank, also attended court.

units.zh: 若拜詔，則但有職事並七品以上散官，皆赴。
units.en: If bowing to an edict, all who held functional posts and honorary offices of the seventh rank and above attended.
units.literal: If bowing to an edict, all who held functional posts and honorary offices of the seventh rank and above attended.

units.zh: 朝參，吏員、令譯史、通事、檢法各於本局待，官員朝退，赴局簽押文字，不得于宮給署押。
units.en: For court attendance, clerks, translators, interpreters, and legal examiners each waited at their bureaus; after officials left court, they went to their bureaus to sign documents and were not permitted to sign in the palace.
units.literal: For court attendance, clerks, translators, interpreters, and legal examiners each waited at their bureaus; after officials left court, they went to their bureaus to sign documents; they were not permitted to sign in the palace.

units.zh: 七品以下流外職，遇朝日亦不合入宮。
units.en: Extra-bureau posts below the seventh rank also should not enter the palace on audience days.
units.literal: Extra-bureau posts below the seventh rank also should not enter the palace on audience days.

units.zh: 如左右司都事有須合取奏事，乃聽入宮。
units.en: Chief clerks of the Left and Right Secretariats, if they needed to present matters, were then permitted to enter the palace.
units.literal: Such as chief clerks of the Left and Right Secretariats, if they needed to present matters, were then permitted to enter the palace.

units.zh: 七品以上職事官，如遇使客朝辭見日，依朔望日，皆赴。
units.en: Functional officials of the seventh rank and above, on days when envoys took leave or were received in audience, all attended as on new- and full-moon days.
units.literal: Functional officials of the seventh rank and above, on days when envoys took leave or were received in audience, all attended as on new- and full-moon days.

units.zh: 若元日、聖節、拜詔、車駕出獵送迎、詣祖廟燒飯，但有職事並七品以上散官，皆赴。
units.en: On New Year's Day, the emperor's birthday, bowing to an edict, sending off or welcoming the imperial procession on a hunt, or going to the ancestral temple to burn offerings—all who held functional posts and honorary offices of the seventh rank and above attended.
units.literal: If it were New Year's Day, the emperor's birthday, bowing to an edict, sending off or welcoming the imperial procession on a hunt, or going to the ancestral temple to burn offerings—all who held functional posts and honorary offices of the seventh rank and above attended.

units.zh: 凡親王宗室已命官者年十六以上，皆隨班赴起居。
units.en: All princes and imperial clansmen who had been granted office, from age sixteen and above, followed their ranks to attend the audience.
units.literal: All princes and imperial clansmen who had been granted office, from age sixteen and above, all followed their ranks to attend the audience.

units.zh: 大定五年，右諫議大夫移剌子敬言：「猛安謀克不得與州鎮官隨班入見，非軍民一體之意。」
units.en: In the fifth year of Dading, Right Remonstrance Grand Master Yelü Zijing said: "The meng'an and mouke may not enter audience with prefectural and garrison officials in the same ranks—this is not in the spirit of treating soldiers and civilians as one body."
units.literal: In the fifth year of Dading, Right Remonstrance Grand Master Yelü Zijing said: "The meng'an and mouke may not enter audience with prefectural and garrison officials in the same ranks—this is not in the spirit of treating soldiers and civilians as one body."

units.zh: 上是其言，責宣徽院令隨班入見。
units.en: The emperor approved his words and charged the Palace Attendant Service to have them enter audience with the ranks.
units.literal: The emperor approved his words and charged the Palace Attendant Service to have them enter audience with the ranks.

units.zh: 凡班首遇朝參，有故不赴，以次押班。
units.en: Whenever a rank leader on court attendance days had cause and could not attend, the next in order led the rank.
units.literal: Whenever a rank leader on court attendance days had cause and could not attend, the next in order led the rank.

units.zh: 凡五品以上及侍御史，尚書諸司郎中、太常丞、翰林修撰起居注、殿中侍御史、補闕、拾遺赴召，或假一月以上若除官出使之類，皆通班入見辭、謝，余官於殿門外見。
units.en: All of the fifth rank and above, attendant censors, bureau directors of the various ministries, vice directors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Hanlin academicians, recorders of the emperor's movements, palace censors, remonstrance officials, and censors who were summoned, or who took leave for a month or more, or who were appointed to office or sent on mission and the like—all entered in a single body to take leave or give thanks; other officials were received outside the hall gate.
units.literal: All of the fifth rank and above, attendant censors, bureau directors of the various ministries, vice directors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Hanlin academicians, recorders of the emperor's movements, palace censors, remonstrance officials, and censors who were summoned, or who took leave for a month or more, or who were appointed to office or sent on mission and the like—all entered in a single body to take leave or give thanks; other officials were received outside the hall gate.

units.zh: 謝班皆舞蹈七拜，辭班四拜，門見謝、辭並再拜。
units.en: Ranks giving thanks all performed the sevenfold ritual dance and bow; ranks taking leave bowed four times; thanks and leave at the gate were both two bows.
units.literal: Ranks giving thanks all performed the sevenfold ritual dance and bow; ranks taking leave bowed four times; thanks and leave at the gate were both two bows.

units.zh: 肆赦儀
units.en: Rites for Proclaiming a General Amnesty
units.literal: Rites for Proclaiming a General Amnesty

units.zh: 大定七年正月十一日，上尊冊禮畢。
units.en: On the eleventh day of the first month of the seventh year of Dading, the rites for bestowing honorific titles were completed.
units.literal: On the eleventh day of the first month of the seventh year of Dading, the rites for bestowing honorific titles were completed.

units.zh: 十四月，應天門頒赦。
units.en: On the fourteenth day, the amnesty was proclaimed at the Gate of Heavenly Response.
units.literal: On the fourteenth day, the amnesty was proclaimed at the Gate of Heavenly Response.

units.zh: 十一年制同。
units.en: In the eleventh year the regulations were the same.
units.literal: In the eleventh year the regulations were the same.

units.zh: 前期，宣徽院使率其屬，陳設應天門之內外，設御座于應天門上，又更衣禦幄于大安殿門外稍東，南向。
units.en: Beforehand, the commissioner of the Palace Attendant Service led his subordinates in arranging the inside and outside of the Gate of Heavenly Response; the imperial throne was set on the gate; a changing pavilion was also set slightly east of the Da'an Hall gate, facing south.
units.literal: Beforehand, the commissioner of the Palace Attendant Service led his subordinates in arranging the inside and outside of the Gate of Heavenly Response; the imperial throne was set on the gate; a changing pavilion was also set slightly east of the Da'an Hall gate, facing south.

units.zh: 閣門使設捧制書箱案于御座之左。
units.en: The gate commissioner set the table and case for holding the edict to the left of the imperial throne.
units.literal: The gate commissioner set the table and case for holding the edict to the left of the imperial throne.

units.zh: 少府監設雞竿于樓下之左，竿上置大盤，盤中置金雞，雞口銜絳幡，幡上金書「大赦天下」四字，卷而銜之。
units.en: The Director of the Palace Storehouses set the rooster pole to the left below the tower; on the pole was placed a great tray; in the tray was placed a golden rooster; the rooster's mouth held a crimson banner inscribed in gold with the four characters "A General Amnesty for All Under Heaven," rolled and held in its mouth.
units.literal: The Director of the Palace Storehouses set the rooster pole to the left below the tower; on the pole was placed a great tray; in the tray was placed a golden rooster; the rooster's mouth held a crimson banner; on the banner the four characters "A General Amnesty for All Under Heaven" were written in gold; it was rolled and held in the mouth.

units.zh: 盤四面近邊安四大鐵鐶，盤底四面近邊懸四大硃索，以備四伎人攀緣。
units.en: On the four sides near the edge of the tray were set four great iron rings; on the four sides near the bottom of the tray were hung four great red ropes, to enable four acrobats to climb.
units.literal: On the four sides near the edge of the tray were set four great iron rings; on the four sides near the bottom of the tray were hung four great red ropes, to enable four acrobats to climb.

units.zh: 又設捧制書木鶴仙人一，以紅繩貫之，引以轆轤，置於御前欄幹上。
units.en: A wooden crane immortal bearing the edict was also set up; a red rope was threaded through it and drawn by a windlass; it was placed on the railing before the emperor.
units.literal: A wooden crane immortal bearing the edict was also set up; a red rope was threaded through it and drawn by a windlass; it was placed on the railing before the emperor.

units.zh: 又設承鶴畫台于樓下正中，台以弩手四人對舉。
units.en: A painted platform to receive the crane was also set at the center below the tower; four crossbowmen faced each other and held it up.
units.literal: A painted platform to receive the crane was also set at the center below the tower; four crossbowmen faced each other and held it up.

units.zh: 大樂署設宮縣於樓下，又設鼓一于宮縣之左稍北，東向。
units.en: The Directorate of Great Music set the palace bell-chime ensemble below the tower; a drum was also set slightly north to the left of the bell-chime ensemble, facing east.
units.literal: The Directorate of Great Music set the palace bell-chime ensemble below the tower; a drum was also set slightly north to the left of the bell-chime ensemble, facing east.

units.zh: 兵部立黃麾仗於門外。
units.en: The Ministry of War posted the yellow-banner guard outside the gate.
units.literal: The Ministry of War posted the yellow-banner guard outside the gate.

units.zh: 刑部、禦史台、大興府以囚徒集于左仗外。
units.en: The Ministry of Justice, the Censorate, and the Daxing Prefecture assembled prisoners outside the left guard.
units.literal: The Ministry of Justice, the Censorate, and the Daxing Prefecture assembled prisoners outside the left guard.

units.zh: 禦史台、閣門司設文武百官位於樓下，東西相向。
units.en: The Censorate and the Gate Service set the stations of the civil and military hundred officials below the tower, east and west facing each other.
units.literal: The Censorate and the Gate Service set the stations of the civil and military hundred officials below the tower, east and west facing each other.

units.zh: 又設典儀位於門下稍東，南向。
units.en: The master of ceremonies' station was also set slightly east below the gate, facing south.
units.literal: The master of ceremonies' station was also set slightly east below the gate, facing south.

units.zh: 宣徽院設承受制書案於畫台之前。
units.en: The Palace Attendant Service set the table for receiving the edict before the painted platform.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant Service set the table for receiving the edict before the painted platform.

units.zh: 又設皇太子侍立褥位於門下稍東，西向。
units.en: The crown prince's standing cushioned station was also set slightly east below the gate, facing west.
units.literal: The crown prince's standing cushioned station was also set slightly east below the gate, facing west.

units.zh: 又設皇太子致賀褥位於百官班前。
units.en: The crown prince's cushioned station for offering congratulations was also set before the hundred officials' ranks.
units.literal: The crown prince's cushioned station for offering congratulations was also set before the hundred officials' ranks.

units.zh: 又設協律郎位於樓上前楹稍東，西向。
units.en: The pitch officer's station was also set slightly east before the front eaves of the tower, facing west.
units.literal: The pitch officer's station was also set slightly east before the front eaves of the tower, facing west.

units.zh: 尚書省委所司設宣制書位於百官班之北稍東，西向。
units.en: The Department of State Affairs delegated the responsible office to set the station for proclaiming the edict slightly east to the north of the hundred officials' ranks, facing west.
units.literal: The Department of State Affairs delegated the responsible office to set the station for proclaiming the edict slightly east to the north of the hundred officials' ranks, facing west.

units.zh: 司天臺設雞唱生於東闕樓之上。
units.en: The Directorate of Astronomy set the rooster-crowing attendant on the eastern tower of the gate.
units.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy set the rooster-crowing attendant on the eastern tower of the gate.

units.zh: 尚衣局備皇帝常服，如常日視朝之服。
units.en: The Bureau of Imperial Vestments prepared the emperor's regular robes, the same as those worn on ordinary days when holding audience.
units.literal: The Bureau of Imperial Vestments prepared the emperor's regular robes, the same as those worn on ordinary days when holding audience.

units.zh: 尚輦設輦於更衣禦幄之前。
units.en: The Bureau of Imperial Transport set the imperial carriage before the changing pavilion.
units.literal: The Bureau of Imperial Transport set the imperial carriage before the changing pavilion.

units.zh: 躬謝禮畢，皇帝乘金輅入應天門，至幄次前，侍中俯伏，跪奏：「請降輅入幄。」
units.en: When the rites of personal thanks were finished, the emperor rode the golden carriage into the Gate of Heavenly Response; reaching before the pavilion station, the Palace Attendant prostrated himself, knelt, and reported: "We request that Your Majesty descend from the carriage and enter the pavilion."
units.literal: When the rites of personal thanks were finished, the emperor rode the golden carriage into the Gate of Heavenly Response; reaching before the pavilion station, the Palace Attendant prostrated himself, knelt, and reported: "We request that Your Majesty descend from the carriage and enter the pavilion."

units.zh: 俯伏，興。
units.en: He prostrated himself and rose.
units.literal: He prostrated himself and rose.

units.zh: 皇帝降輅入幄，簾降。
units.en: The emperor descended from the carriage and entered the pavilion; the curtain was lowered.
units.literal: The emperor descended from the carriage and entered the pavilion; the curtain was lowered.

units.zh: 少頃，侍中奏：「中嚴。」
units.en: After a short while, the Palace Attendant reported: "Strict guard within."
units.literal: After a short while, the Palace Attendant reported: "Strict guard within."

units.zh: 又少頃，俟典贊儀引皇太子就門下侍立位，通事舍人引群官就門下分班相向立，侍中奏：「外辦。」
units.en: After another short while, when the master of ceremonies had led the crown prince to his standing station below the gate, and communication officers had led the hundred officials to their stations below the gate in facing ranks, the Palace Attendant reported: "All is ready outside."
units.literal: After another short while, when the master of ceremonies had led the crown prince to his standing station below the gate, and communication officers had led the hundred officials to their stations below the gate in facing ranks, the Palace Attendant reported: "All is ready outside."

units.zh: 皇帝服常朝服，尚輦進輦，侍中奏：「請升輦。」
units.en: The emperor put on his regular court robes; the Bureau of Imperial Transport brought forward the carriage; the Palace Attendant reported: "We request that Your Majesty ascend the carriage."
units.literal: The emperor put on his regular court robes; the Bureau of Imperial Transport brought forward the carriage; the Palace Attendant reported: "We request that Your Majesty ascend the carriage."

units.zh: 傘扇侍衛如常儀，由左翔龍門踏道升應天門，至御座東，侍中奏：「請降輦升座。」
units.en: Umbrellas, fans, and guards attended as in the regular rites; by the left Xianglong Gate ramp he ascended the Gate of Heavenly Response; reaching the east of the imperial throne, the Palace Attendant reported: "We request that Your Majesty descend from the carriage and ascend the throne."
units.literal: Umbrellas, fans, and guards attended as in the regular rites; by the left Xianglong Gate ramp he ascended the Gate of Heavenly Response; reaching the east of the imperial throne, the Palace Attendant reported: "We request that Your Majesty descend from the carriage and ascend the throne."

units.zh: 宮縣樂作。
units.en: The palace bell-chime ensemble played.
units.literal: The palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 所司索扇五十柄，扇合，皇帝臨軒即御座，樓下鳴鞭，簾卷扇開，執禦傘者張於軒前以障日，樂止。
units.en: The responsible offices summoned fifty folding fans; the fans closed; the emperor approached the balcony and took the imperial throne; whips sounded below the tower; the curtain was raised and the fans opened; bearers of the imperial umbrella spread them before the balcony to shield the sun, and the music stopped.
units.literal: The responsible offices summoned fifty folding fans; the fans closed; the emperor approached the balcony and took the imperial throne; whips sounded below the tower; the curtain was raised and the fans opened; bearers of the imperial umbrella spread them before the balcony to shield the sun; the music ceased.

units.zh: 東上閣門使捧制書置於箱，閣門舍人二員從，以俟引繩降木鶴仙人。
units.en: The eastern gate commissioner held the edict and placed it in the case; two gate officers followed, to await drawing the rope to lower the wooden crane immortal.
units.literal: The eastern gate commissioner held the edict and placed it in the case; two gate officers followed, to await drawing the rope to lower the wooden crane immortal.

units.zh: 通事舍人引文武群官合班北向立，宮縣樂作。
units.en: Communication officers led the civil and military officials to combine ranks and stand facing north as the palace bell-chime ensemble played.
units.literal: Communication officers led the civil and military officials to form a single body and stand facing north; the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 凡分班、合班則樂作，立定即止。
units.en: Whenever the ranks divided or combined, music played; when they held position, it stopped.
units.literal: Whenever ranks were divided or combined, music would play; when they stood firm, it ceased.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 在位官皆再拜，訖，分班相向立。
units.en: Every official on duty bowed twice; when finished, they divided into facing ranks.
units.literal: All officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, they divided into ranks facing each other.

units.zh: 侍中詣御座前承旨，退，稍前南向，宣曰：「奉敕樹金雞。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant went before the imperial throne to receive the command, withdrew, stepped forward facing south, and announced: "By imperial command, erect the golden rooster."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant proceeded before the imperial throne to receive the imperial command, withdrew, advanced slightly facing south, and proclaimed: "By imperial command, erect the golden rooster."

units.zh: 通事舍人于門下稍前東向，宣曰：「奉敕樹金雞。」
units.en: A communication officer stepped slightly forward below the gate, facing east, and announced: "By imperial command, erect the golden rooster."
units.literal: A communication officer, slightly forward below the gate facing east, proclaimed: "By imperial command, erect the golden rooster."

units.zh: 退復位。
units.en: He withdrew and returned to his place.
units.literal: He withdrew and returned to his station.

units.zh: 金雞初立，大樂署擊鼓，樹訖鼓止。
units.en: As the golden rooster was first raised, the Directorate of Great Music beat the drum; when it was fully erected, the drumming stopped.
units.literal: When the golden rooster was first erected, the Directorate of Great Music struck the drum; when the erection was finished, the drum ceased.

units.zh: 竿木伎人四人，緣繩爭上竿，取雞所銜絳幡，展示訖，三呼「萬歲」。
units.en: Four pole-and-rope acrobats raced up the ropes to the pole, seized the crimson banner from the rooster's mouth, and when the display was done thrice cried "Long live the emperor!"
units.literal: Four pole-and-rope acrobats, climbing the ropes in competition to ascend the pole, took the crimson banner held in the rooster's mouth; when the display was finished, they thrice cried "Long live [the emperor]!"

units.zh: 通事舍人引文武群官合班北向立。
units.en: Communication officers led the civil and military officials to combine ranks and stand facing north.
units.literal: Communication officers led the civil and military officials to form a single body and stand facing north.

units.zh: 樓上乘鶴仙人捧制書，循繩而下至畫台，閣使奉承置於案。
units.en: On the tower, the crane immortal bearing the edict descended along the rope to the painted platform; the gate commissioner received it with both hands and placed it on the table.
units.literal: Above on the tower, the crane immortal bearing the edict, following the rope, descended to the painted platform; the gate commissioner respectfully received it and placed it on the table.

units.zh: 閣門舍人四員舉案，又二員對捧制書，閣使引至班前，西向稱：「有制。」
units.en: Four gate officers lifted the table while two more faced each other and held the edict between them; the gate commissioner led them before the ranks and, facing west, announced: "There is an edict."
units.literal: Four gate officers raised the table; two more faced each other and held the edict between them; the gate commissioner led them before the ranks and, facing west, proclaimed: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 在位官皆再拜，訖，以制書授尚書省長官，稍前搢笏，跪受，訖，以付右司官，右司官搢笏，跪受，訖，長官出笏，俯伏，興，退復位。
units.en: Every official on duty bowed twice. The edict was handed to the chief of the Department of State Affairs, who stepped forward, tucked his tablet in his belt, knelt, and received it, then passed it to the Right Section officer. The Right Section officer tucked his tablet, knelt, and received it. The chief then withdrew his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and returned to his place.
units.literal: All officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, the edict was handed to the chief of the Department of State Affairs; he advanced slightly, tucked his tablet in his belt, knelt and received it; when finished, he passed it to the Right Section officer; the Right Section officer tucked his tablet, knelt and received it; when finished, the chief withdrew his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, withdrew, and returned to his station.

units.zh: 右司官捧制書詣宣制位，都事對捧，右司官宣讀，至「鹹赦除之」。
units.en: The Right Section officer carried the edict to the proclamation station; the chief clerk held it opposite him while the Right Section officer read it aloud, down to the words "all are hereby pardoned."
units.literal: The Right Section officer held the edict and proceeded to the station for proclaiming the edict; the chief clerk held it facing him; the Right Section officer proclaimed and read it, down to "all are hereby pardoned."

units.zh: 所司帥獄吏引罪人詣班南，北向，躬稱：「脫枷。」
units.en: The responsible office had prison officers lead the prisoners to the south side of the ranks; facing north, they bowed and called: "Remove the collars."
units.literal: The responsible office led prison officers to bring the criminals before the south of the ranks; facing north, they bowed and called: "Remove the cangue."

units.zh: 訖，三呼「萬歲」，以罪人過。
units.en: When this was done, they thrice cried "Long live the emperor!"; the prisoners were then led past.
units.literal: When finished, they thrice cried "Long live [the emperor]!"; the criminals were led past.

units.zh: 右司官宣制訖，西向，以制書授刑部官。
units.en: When the Right Section officer had finished reading the edict, facing west, he handed it to the Ministry of Justice officer.
units.literal: When the Right Section officer had finished proclaiming the edict, facing west, he handed the edict to the Ministry of Justice officer.

units.zh: 跪受訖，以制書加於笏上，退以付其屬，歸本班。
units.en: He knelt to receive it, placed the edict atop his tablet, withdrew and handed it to his subordinates, and returned to his rank.
units.literal: He knelt and received it; when finished, he placed the edict on his tablet, withdrew and passed it to his subordinates, and returned to his original rank.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 在位官皆再拜，舞蹈，又再拜。
units.en: Every official on duty bowed twice, performed the dance-obeisance, and bowed again.
units.literal: All officials in attendance bowed twice, performed ritual dance, and bowed again.

units.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子至班前褥位立定，典儀曰：「拜。」
units.en: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince to the cushioned station before the ranks; the master of ceremonies called: "Bow."
units.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince to the cushioned station before the ranks and held position; the master of ceremonies said: "Bow."

units.zh: 皇太子以下群官皆再拜。
units.en: From the crown prince down, every official bowed twice.
units.literal: From the crown prince down, all officials bowed twice.

units.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子稍前，俯伏，跪致詞，俯伏，興。
units.en: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince slightly forward; he prostrated himself, knelt and delivered an address, prostrated himself again, and rose.
units.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince slightly forward; he prostrated himself, knelt and delivered an address, prostrated himself, and rose.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 皇太子以下群官皆再拜，搢笏，舞蹈，又再拜。
units.en: From the crown prince down, every official bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance-obeisance, and bowed again.
units.literal: From the crown prince down, all officials bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, and bowed again.

units.zh: 侍中於御座前承旨，退臨軒宣曰：「有制。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant received the command before the imperial throne, withdrew to the balcony, and announced: "There is an edict."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant received the imperial command before the imperial throne, withdrew to the balcony, and proclaimed: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 皇太子以下群官皆再拜。
units.en: From the crown prince down, every official bowed twice.
units.literal: From the crown prince down, all officials bowed twice.

units.zh: 侍中宣答，宣訖歸侍位，典儀曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant read the imperial response; when he had finished he returned to his station, and the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant proclaimed the response; when the proclamation was finished he returned to his attendant station; the master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 皇太子已下群官皆再拜，搢笏，舞蹈，又再拜，訖，典贊儀引皇太子至門下褥位，通事舍人引群官分班相向立。
units.en: From the crown prince down, every official bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance-obeisance, and bowed again. The master of ritual praise then led the crown prince to the cushioned station below the gate, and communication officers led the officials to divide into facing ranks.
units.literal: From the crown prince down, all officials bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, and bowed again; when finished, the master of ritual praise led the crown prince to the cushioned station below the gate; communication officers led the hundred officials to divide into ranks facing each other.

units.zh: 侍中詣御座前，俯伏，跪奏：「禮畢。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant went before the imperial throne, prostrated himself, knelt, and reported: "The rites are complete."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant proceeded before the imperial throne, prostrated himself, knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."

units.zh: 俯伏，興，退復位。
units.en: He prostrated himself, rose, withdrew, and returned to his place.
units.literal: He prostrated himself, rose, withdrew, and returned to his station.

units.zh: 所司索扇，宮縣樂作，扇合，簾降，皇帝降座，樂止。
units.en: The responsible offices summoned the fans; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; the fans closed, the curtain was lowered, and the emperor descended from the throne as the music stopped.
units.literal: The responsible offices summoned the fans; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; the fans closed; the curtain was lowered; the emperor descended from the throne; the music ceased.

units.zh: 樓下鳴鞭，皇帝乘輦還內，傘扇侍衛如常儀。
units.en: Whips sounded below the tower; the emperor rode his carriage back to the inner palace with umbrellas, fans, and guards attending as usual.
units.literal: Whips sounded below the tower; the emperor rode the carriage back to the inner palace; umbrellas, fans, and guards attended as in the regular rites.

units.zh: 侍中奏：「解嚴。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant reported: "Strict guard is lifted."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant reported: "Strict guard is lifted."

units.zh: 通事舍人承敕，群臣各還次，將士各還本所。
units.en: Communication officers received the command; the officials each returned to their stations and the soldiers to their posts.
units.literal: Communication officers received the imperial command; the hundred officials each returned to their stations; soldiers each returned to their posts.

units.zh: 臣下拜赦詔儀
units.en: Ceremonies for Officials Bowing to Amnesty Edicts
units.literal: Ceremonies for Officials Bowing to Amnesty Edicts

units.zh: 宣赦日，于應天門外設香案，及設香輿於案前，又於東側設卓子，自皇太子宰臣以下序班定。
units.en: On the day the amnesty was proclaimed, an incense table was set outside the Gate of Heavenly Response with an incense carriage before it and a reading desk to the east; from the crown prince and chief ministers down, all took their places in order.
units.literal: On the day the amnesty was proclaimed, an incense table was set outside the Gate of Heavenly Response, and an incense carriage was set before the table; a reading desk was also set on the east side; from the crown prince and chief ministers down, they took their places in order.

units.zh: 閣門官於箱內捧赦書出門置於案。
units.en: Gate officers took the amnesty edict from the case, went out the gate, and placed it on the table.
units.literal: Gate officers, holding the amnesty edict from within the case, went out the gate and placed it on the table.

units.zh: 閣門官案東立，南向稱：「有敕。」
units.en: A gate officer stood east of the table, facing south, and announced: "There is an imperial command."
units.literal: The gate officer stood east of the table, facing south, and proclaimed: "There is an imperial command."

units.zh: 贊皇太子宰臣百僚再拜，皇太子少前上香訖，復位，皆再拜。
units.en: The announcer called for the crown prince, chief ministers, and hundred officials to bow twice; the crown prince stepped forward to offer incense, returned to his place, and all bowed again.
units.literal: The announcer led the crown prince, chief ministers, and hundred officials to bow twice; the crown prince advanced slightly, offered incense, and when finished returned to his station; all bowed again.

units.zh: 閣門官取赦書授尚書省都事，都事跪受，及尚書省令史二人齊捧，同升于卓子讀，在位官皆跪聽，讀訖，赦書置於案，都事復位。
units.en: The gate officer handed the amnesty edict to the chief clerk of the Department of State Affairs, who knelt to receive it. He and two Department of State Affairs clerks then jointly carried it up to the reading desk and read it aloud while every official on duty knelt to listen. When the reading was finished, the edict was placed on the table and the chief clerk returned to his place.
units.literal: The gate officer took the amnesty edict and handed it to the chief clerk of the Department of State Affairs; the chief clerk knelt and received it; together with two Department of State Affairs clerks they jointly held it, ascended together to the reading desk and read it; all officials in attendance knelt and listened; when the reading was finished, the amnesty edict was placed on the table and the chief clerk returned to his station.

units.zh: 皇太子宰臣百僚以下再拜，搢笏，舞蹈，執笏，俯伏，興，再拜。
units.en: From the crown prince and chief ministers down, all bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance-obeisance, took up their tablets, prostrated themselves, rose, and bowed again.
units.literal: From the crown prince, chief ministers, and hundred officials down, all bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed ritual dance, took their tablets, prostrated themselves, rose, and bowed again.

units.zh: 拱衛直以下三稱「萬歲」，訖，退。
units.en: The Palace Guard units and below thrice cried "Long live the emperor!"; when finished, they withdrew.
units.literal: From the Palace Guard units down, they thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!"; when finished, they withdrew.

units.zh: 其降諸書，禮亦准此，惟不稱「萬歲」。
units.en: For lower-level proclamations, the rites followed the same procedure, except that "Long live the emperor!" was not cried.
units.literal: For downward edicts, the rites likewise followed this, only without proclaiming "Long live [the emperor]!"

units.zh: 其外郡，尚書省差官送赦書到京府節鎮，先遣人報，長官即率僚屬吏從，備旗幟音樂彩輿香輿，詣五裏外迎。
units.en: In the outer prefectures, when the Department of State Affairs dispatched an officer to deliver the amnesty edict to the capital prefecture or a military commissioner, he sent word ahead; the chief officer then led his subordinates, clerks, and attendants out five li with banners, music, a decorated carriage, and an incense carriage to welcome him.
units.literal: In outer prefectures, when the Department of State Affairs dispatched an officer to deliver the amnesty edict to the capital prefecture or a military commissioner, he first sent someone ahead to report; the chief officer then led his subordinates, clerks, and attendants, prepared banners, music, a decorated carriage, and an incense carriage, and went to welcome them five li outside.

units.zh: 見送赦書官，即於道側下馬，所差官亦下馬，取赦書置彩輿中，長官詣香輿前上香，訖，所差官上馬，在香輿後，長官以下皆上馬後從，鳴鉦鼓作樂導至公㕔，從正門入，所差官下馬。
units.en: On meeting the officer bearing the amnesty edict, both parties dismounted at the roadside. The dispatched officer placed the edict in the decorated carriage; the chief officer stepped before the incense carriage to offer incense. The dispatched officer then mounted and rode behind the incense carriage while the chief officer and his party mounted and followed, with gongs, drums, and music escorting them to the government hall. They entered by the main gate and the dispatched officer dismounted.
units.literal: On seeing the officer delivering the amnesty edict, they immediately dismounted at the roadside; the dispatched officer also dismounted; he took the amnesty edict and placed it in the decorated carriage; the chief officer proceeded before the incense carriage and offered incense; when finished, the dispatched officer mounted and rode behind the incense carriage; the chief officer and below all mounted and followed behind; gongs and drums sounded and music played as they escorted him to the government hall; they entered by the main gate; the dispatched officer dismounted.

units.zh: 執事者先設案並望闕褥位於庭中，香輿置於案之前，又設所差官褥位在案之側，又設卓子於案之東南。
units.en: Attendants first set a table and a cushioned place facing the palace in the courtyard, with the incense carriage before the table; they also set the dispatched officer's cushioned station beside the table and a reading desk southeast of it.
units.literal: Attendants first set a table and a cushioned place facing the palace in the courtyard; the incense carriage was placed before the table; the dispatched officer's cushioned station was also set beside the table; a reading desk was also set southeast of the table.

units.zh: 所差官取赦書置於案，彩輿退。
units.en: The dispatched officer placed the amnesty edict on the table and the decorated carriage withdrew.
units.literal: The dispatched officer took the amnesty edict and placed it on the table; the decorated carriage withdrew.

units.zh: 所差官稱：「有敕。」
units.en: The dispatched officer announced: "There is an imperial command."
units.literal: The dispatched officer proclaimed: "There is an imperial command."

units.zh: 長官以下皆再拜。
units.en: From the chief officer down, all bowed twice.
units.literal: From the chief officer down, all bowed twice.

units.zh: 長官少前上香，訖，退復位，又再拜。
units.en: The chief officer stepped forward to offer incense, returned to his place, and bowed again.
units.literal: The chief officer advanced slightly and offered incense; when finished, he withdrew and returned to his station and bowed again.

units.zh: 所差官取赦書授都目，都目跪受，及孔目官二員，三人齊捧赦書，同高幾上宣讀，在位官皆跪聽。
units.en: The dispatched officer handed the amnesty edict to the chief registrar, who knelt to receive it. He and two document clerks then jointly carried the edict to the high lectern and read it aloud while every official on duty knelt to listen.
units.literal: The dispatched officer took the amnesty edict and handed it to the chief registrar; the chief registrar knelt and received it; together with two document clerks, the three jointly held the amnesty edict and together read it aloud from the high lectern; all officials in attendance knelt and listened.

units.zh: 讀訖，都目等復位。
units.en: When the reading was finished, the chief registrar and his clerks returned to their places.
units.literal: When the reading was finished, the chief registrar and the others returned to their stations.

units.zh: 長官以下再拜，舞蹈，俯伏，興，再拜。
units.en: From the chief officer down, all bowed twice, performed the dance-obeisance, prostrated themselves, rose, and bowed again.
units.literal: From the chief officer down, all bowed twice, performed ritual dance, prostrated themselves, rose, and bowed again.

units.zh: 公吏以下三稱「萬歲」。
units.en: The clerks and attendants thrice cried "Long live the emperor!"
units.literal: From the clerks and attendants down, they thrice proclaimed "Long live [the emperor]!"

units.zh: 禮畢。
units.en: The rites were complete.
units.literal: The rites were complete.

units.zh: 明日，長官率僚屬，音樂送至郭外。
units.en: The next day, the chief officer led his subordinates and, with music playing, escorted the dispatched officer to beyond the outer wall.
units.literal: The next day, the chief officer led his subordinates; with music they escorted him to outside the outer wall.
